plugins.readme_text: # dsh-theme-button 给 **DeepSeek Harness** 桌面版加一个悬浮主题挂件：切换官方外观，以及设置一层自定义背景。 挂件浮在界面之上，可以拖到任何位置并记住位置。所有界面自带半透明毛玻璃效果。 ## 效果展示 | 自定义背景：关闭 | 自定义背景：纯色 | | --- | --- | | | | | 自绘取色器 | 自定义背景：图片 | | --- | --- | | | | 面板、挂件、取色板都是半透明毛玻璃，只在自定义背景开启时生效。 ## 功能 | 功能 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | 悬浮挂件 | 默认在右下角，可拖动；位置自动记住；轻点开关面板，拖动时自动收起面板 | | 官方外观 | 浅色 / 深色 / 跟随系统，写回 DSH 官方外观设置，不是插件自己的一套 | | 自定义背景 | 纯色（6 个预设 + 自绘取色器）或图片（最多 6 张），二选一 | | 背景参数 | 不透明度、模糊、亮度、饱和度，图片与纯色各有独立的不透明度 | | 适配方式 | 填充 / 适应 / 平铺 / 拉伸 | | 毛玻璃 | 挂件、面板、取色板三者一致；关闭自定义背景即恢复 DSH 原生外观 | ## 环境要求 - DeepSeek Harness 桌面版（Windows） - 无需额外依赖 ## 安装 先取得插件文件，再让 DSH 加载它。 ### 方式一：本地链接安装（推荐） 把插件文件夹放到一个**固定的位置**（装好后不要再移动），然后执行： ```powershell dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:C:\dsh-plugins\dsh-theme-button ``` ### 方式二：从发布包安装 1. 解压发布包到一个固定位置，例如 `C:\dsh-plugins\dsh-theme-button` 2. 在该目录下运行： ```powershell .\install.ps1 ``` 或者手工执行上面那条 `dsh plugin ... add link:` 命令。 ### 完成后必须重启 **请完全退出并重新启动 DSH。** 插件的宿主部分只在启动时加载，仅刷新页面不够。 ### 验证安装成功 重启后应该看到右下角出现一个调色板图标按钮。也可以访问： - `http://127.0.0.1:/dsh-theme-button/version` —— 应返回一个版本号 ## 使用方法 ### 挂件 | 操作 | 效果 | | --- | --- | | 轻点 | 打开 / 关闭设置面板 | | 按住拖动 | 移动挂件位置，鼠标变为抓手，面板自动收起；松手后位置自动保存 | | 位置 | 重开 DSH 后保持上次位置；不会超出屏幕，也不会进入窗口按钮那一行 | ### 官方外观 面板第一段是「外观」，三选一：浅色 / 深色 / 跟随系统。选择会同步到 DSH 官方外观设置，与官方设置页双向一致。 ### 自定义背景 面板第二段是「自定义背景」，总开关默认**关闭**。 打开总开关后，选择背景来源： - **纯色**：点色板里的预设，或点最右边的方块打开取色器自定义 - **图片**：点「添加图片」选图，最多 6 张；点缩略图切换，点缩略图上的 × 删除 图片放满 6 张后，「添加图片」会自动变灰禁用；删掉一张即恢复。 ### 取色器 | 操作 | 效果 | | --- | --- | | 上方方形区域 | 拖动手柄调整饱和度与明度 | | 中间彩色条 | 拖动手柄调整色相，圆环中显示当前选中的颜色 | | 底部输入框 | 手动输入颜色值，回车或点击别处即生效 | | ▴ ▾ 按钮 | 在 HEX / RGB / HSL 三种格式之间切换 | 输入时三种格式都认：即使当前显示的是 HEX，直接输入 `rgb(255, 0, 0)` 也会按 RGB 解析。 ### 参数说明 | 参数 | 范围 | 说明 | | --- | --- | --- | | 不透明度（图片） | 0–10 | 图片的显示强度，0 等于关闭整个效果 | | 不透明度（纯色） | 0–10 | 纯色独立的一份，与图片那份互不影响 | | 模糊 | 0–24px | 背景的模糊程度，默认 0 | | 亮度 | 0–10 | 5 为 100%，即不做调整 | | 饱和度 | 0–10 | 5 为 100%，即不做调整 | ### 适配方式 | 方式 | 效果 | | --- | --- | | 填充 | 铺满整个区域，超出部分裁掉（默认） | | 适应 | 完整显示整张图，可能留边 | | 平铺 | 按原尺寸重复平铺 | | 拉伸 | 拉伸到铺满，会变形 | ## 首次安装的默认值 | 项目 | 默认值 | | --- | --- | | 挂件位置 | 右下角 | | 外观 | 跟随系统 | | 自定义背景 | 关闭 | | 背景来源 | 未选择 | | 取色器颜色 | `#8FB3A5` | | 图片 | 无 | | 适配方式 | 填充 | | 不透明度 | 5 / 10 | | 模糊 | 0px | | 亮度 / 饱和度 | 5 / 10（100%） | 设置保存在本机浏览器存储中，重开 DSH 后全部沿用（面板的开 / 关状态除外）。 ## 卸载 ```powershell dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-theme-button ``` 然后重启 DSH。如果还要清掉本机保存的设置，见「常见问题」最后一条。 ## 常见问题 **挂件没有出现** 确认已经**完全重启** DSH，而不是只刷新页面。再访问 `/dsh-theme-button/version` 看是否返回版本号。 **背景效果看不见** 先确认「自定义背景」总开关是打开的，且不透明度不为 0。 **侧边栏 / 某个区域没有效果** 少数情况下背景层需要界面自身发生变化才会重新计算。切换一下图片或颜色，或打开一个新会话即可恢复。 **改了插件文件没有生效** `lib/client.js`（界面部分）会自动重载，但同一版本 10 秒内最多重载 3 次，超过请手动刷新页面。`lib/index.js`（宿主部分）必须重启 DSH。 **想恢复出厂设置** 打开开发者工具，执行下面这行后刷新页面： ```js localStorage.removeItem('dsh-theme-button.state.v2') ``` ## 反馈问题 **这个项目不保证持续更新**，所以反馈的意义不是"让我去改"，而是**把问题记录下来**： 让后来遇到同样情况的人能在这里搜到答案，也让将来想接手的人知道有哪些坑。 所以无论你只是想说一句"这里好像不对"，还是发现了具体的 Bug，都欢迎告诉我： | 请提供 | 在哪看 | | --- | --- | | 你做了什么操作 | 越具体越好 | | 期望的结果 / 实际的结果 | 分别是什么 | | 插件版本 | `package.json` 里的 `version`，或访问 `/dsh-theme-button/version` | | DSH 版本 | DSH 的「关于」页 | | 截图 | 最有效，能省很多来回 | **联系方式** - **邮箱：`zhanghz1130@outlook.com`**（标题里带上 `dsh-theme-button`，方便我归档） - **GitHub Issues**：[提交 Issue](../../../issues) —— 推荐用这个，问题公开留存，别人能直接看到 **我不承诺一定会修**，但会尽量看一眼。如果问题只影响你的个别情况，也欢迎自行修改—— MIT 许可，随便改、随便发。 ## 已知限制 - 只支持 Windows 桌面版 DSH（边框预留区的处理依赖 Windows 窗口变量） - 取色器与面板都绘制在自己的浮层里，不会与 DSH 原生菜单抢占最上层：DSH 自己的菜单和对话框会盖住它们 - 图片上限 6 张，且受浏览器存储容量限制 ## 项目文件 | 文件 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `package.json` | 插件清单 | | `cordis.patch.yml` | 让 DSH 在启动时加载本插件 | | `lib/index.js` | 宿主部分：注册路由、注入页面脚本、读写外观偏好 | | `lib/client.js` | 界面部分：挂件、面板、取色器、背景效果 | | `install.ps1` | 安装辅助脚本 | | `LICENSE` | 许可协议 | `_dev/` 是开发资料（历史备份与补丁脚本），不参与分发，可以删除。 ## 开发 ```powershell # 打包：只收集该分发的文件，输出到 dist/ .\pack.ps1 ``` 改完 `lib/client.js` 后页面会自动重载（它每 2.5 秒检查一次版本号）；改完 `lib/index.js` 需要重启 DSH。 代码里有较多注释，说明了每一处设计的取舍；遇到疑问也欢迎直接[反馈](#反馈问题)。 ## 关于这个项目 这个插件是**用 AI 辅助完成的**。我本人不是程序员，没有独立写出这些代码的技术能力， 但我投入了大量时间去提需求、试效果、找问题、反复验证，也承担了 AI 开发工具的费用。 > **项目状态**：功能已完整可用。我**不承诺持续更新**——它现在够用，我就不一定继续折腾了。 > 代码是 MIT 许可，任何人都可以自己改、自己发。 如果你觉得它好用，欢迎请我喝杯水。感谢你的支持！ ### 感谢支持 --- ## 许可 MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

plugins.description: Selection quoting and anchored annotations for DSH conversations: quote a passage and the model receives the exact turn, role and text. · 划词批注与引用锚点：选中文字带锚点进入输入框，可跳回原文并高亮；发送后模型知道是哪一轮、谁说的。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-quote-annotate-pro

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-quote-annotate-pro?color=2ea44f&label=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-quote-annotate-pro)
[![ci](https://github.com/zhao-guang-ai/dsh-quote-annotate-pro/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/zhao-guang-ai/dsh-quote-annotate-pro/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](./LICENSE)

**在 DSH 会话里划词 → 批注 → 引用**：选中的文字变成带锚点的引用进入输入框，发送时序列化为结构化引用块；输入框下方常驻一条**引用导航条**，点一下就能跳回原文并高亮。多轮对话里，模型看到的是 `【引用 · 第N轮 · 你的消息】`，不再需要猜"你说的是哪一处"。

> 这是 [`dsh-quote-annotate`](https://github.com/wangwei-wade/dsh-quote-annotate)（MIT，作者 wangwei-wade）的增强 fork。
> 上游 v0.1.1 在 **DSH 0.2.0-rc.2** 上会**静默失效**（既不报错也不注册任何 UI），本 fork 修掉了 4 个兼容性问题，
> 并补上了 3 项能力；另有 2 个接口变化（当前会话、chip DOM 定位）一并适配。许可仍为 MIT，见 [LICENSE](./LICENSE)。
> 完整汇总见 [SUMMARY.md](./SUMMARY.md)。

## 功能

| 能力 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 划词批注 | 会话里选中任意文字 → 选区上方浮出气泡（预览 + 「批注」）→ 编辑框里写评语（可留空）→ `Enter` 插入 |
| 引用 chip | 输入框里出现 `引用#1 · 第5轮 · DSH 回复` 的原子 chip；发送时展开为完整引用块 |
| **引用导航条** | 输入框下方常驻 `引用 ❝ 引用#1 …`，**点击跳回原文并高亮**，悬停预览原文 |
| **模型侧精确定位** | 引用块首行是 `【引用 · 第5轮 · 你的消息】`，后接 `> 原文`，让模型明确知道**哪一轮、谁说的** |
| 回合级引用 | 每条已完成回合尾部有「引用提问 / 引用回答」，整段引用该轮 |
| 锚点持久化 | `ref → 锚点` 映射写入 `localStorage`（按会话，最多 60 条），**刷新页面后引用条仍能跳回原文** |
| 中英自适应 | 按钮文案跟随界面语言（沿用上游） |

## 与上游的差异

### 兼容性修复（否则整插件静默失效）

1. **缺 cordis 依赖声明** —— 上游 `apply(ctx)` 里 `const slots = ctx.get('slots')`，拿不到就 `return`。
   没有声明 `inject: ['slots']` 时 `apply` 可能早于 slots 服务就绪执行，于是**无声退出，一个 UI 都不注册**。
   → 本 fork 声明 `exports.name` + `exports.inject = ['slots']`，并给每一步注册加 `try/catch` + 上报。

2. **`conversation.chat.turnTail` 已从 chain 变 list**（DSH 0.1.6-alpha.2 起）—— 上游仍用 `{ select, priority }` 注册，
   会抛错；而它排在 4 个 overlay 注册**之前**，一崩全崩。→ 改为 `{ name, id, order }`。

3. **chip 插入 API 变了** —— 上游调用 `input.insertReference(...)`，该对象在本版本没有此方法，永远退化为纯文本。
   → 改走官方会话事件 `slash/input-insert-reference`（与 `dsh-better-sidebar` 同一条在本版本已验证的通路）。

4. **回合尾部按钮不出现（快照形状变了）** —— 上游用 `useSession` 的快照 + `Array.isArray(snapshot.nodes)` + 节点 `seq`
   来取该轮文本；本版本真实形状是 **Chat 快照（`useChat`）**、**`nodes` 是 Map**、**节点身份是 `anchorSeq`**、
   文本在 `user.data.content[{type:'text'}]` / `assistant-step.data.blocks[{kind:'text'}]`，
   assistant 节点 kind 也不是 `assistant` 而是 `assistant-step`。→ 全部按本版本形状重写取文与锚点解析。

### 能力增强

5. **当前会话解析** —— 上游读 `useSessions(s => s.current)`，而**本版本会话列表快照没有 `current` 字段**（恒为 `undefined`），
   导致点「批注」只关掉气泡、什么都不发生。→ 改为由**会话作用域槽位**（`conversation.input.dock` 探针）回填 `sessionId`，
   并去掉"必须先解析到会话才开编辑框"的门槛（解析失败也照常进入编辑，插入时再解析）。

6. **引用块带轮次/角色** —— 上游只发 `> 原文`。→ 首行加 `【引用 · 第N轮 · 角色】`（轮次取自 `data-chat-turn`，角色取自 `data-chat-flow-kind`）。

7. **引用导航条 + 锚点持久化** —— 本版本输入框 chip **没有 `data-*` 属性**（只有 CSS 类），上游"点 chip 跳转"不可能成立。
   → 改为读官方输入状态 `occurrences`（`source === 'quote-ref'`）渲染导航条；`ref → 锚点` 落 `localStorage`，刷新后仍可跳。
   （输入框 chip 本体也支持点击跳转：按 `title` = label 反查 ref，不依赖 CSS 类顺序。）

## 安装

```sh
# 从 npm 安装（推荐，一步到位）
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-quote-annotate-pro

# 或直接从 GitHub 安装
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:zhao-guang-ai/dsh-quote-annotate-pro

# 本地开发：
#   <本仓库绝对路径> 为克隆后的目录；link 安装后改文件即刻热更，无需重启
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add <本仓库绝对路径>
```

装好后 profile 的 `package.json` 会出现：

```
"dsh-quote-annotate-pro": "link:<本仓库绝对路径>"
```

## 工作原理

```
选中文字
  │ 气泡「批注」→ 编辑框 → Enter
  ▼
emit('slash/input-insert-reference', { reference, span })      ← 官方会话事件，会话作用域
  │ 输入机 mint 一条 occurrence（source='quote-ref' / ref / label）
  ▼
输入框 chip（官方 Lexical 装饰节点）
  │ 发送
  ▼
本插件 codec.serialize(ref) → 完整引用块
     【引用 · 第5轮 · DSH 回复】
     > 原文……
     （你的评语）
  ▼
模型收到"哪一轮 + 谁说的 + 原文"

跳回原文：导航条/锚点 → [data-chat-anchor-key] 行 → scrollIntoView + 高亮
```

用到的官方接口：`slots`（`shell.overlay` / `conversation.chat.turnTail` / `conversation.input.dock`）、
`conversation.input`（草稿 + occurrences）、`sessions.binding/scope`、`inputTriggers.registerSource` + codec、
DOM 锚点 `data-chat-anchor-key` / `data-chat-turn`。

## 开发

```
lib/client.js          全部功能（手写 bundle，无构建步骤 —— 改完保存即生效）
tools/diag-sink.mjs    本地诊断接收端（可选）
tools/check-manifest.mjs  清单一致性自检（CI 同款）
```

```sh
npm run check    # 校验 package.json / patch / bundle 注册 id 是否一致
npm run diag     # 起诊断接收端（默认 http://127.0.0.1:47821）
```

改完 `lib/client.js` **无需重启 DSH**：宿主按磁盘内容提供 bundle，客户端 HMR 检测到内容变化会自动热更该插件。

### 诊断通道（开发期）

`lib/client.js` 顶部有：

```js
const DIAG_ENABLED = true
const DIAG_URL = 'http://127.0.0.1:47821/dsh-quote-pro'
```

插件启动时 POST 一次 `/ping`；**探测不到接收端就本次运行静默**（不会产生网络噪音）。
配合 `npm run diag`，终端会实时打出全链路事件：

```
module:materialized / apply:start / register:ok …   插件加载与槽位注册
selection:show / selection:stage                    划词与「批注」
insert:chip / insert:fallback-plaintext             引用插入（chip 或纯文本回退）
dock:rows / dock:click / jump:ok / toast            导航条与跳回原文
turnTail:render                                     回合尾部按钮取文
```

不需要时把 `DIAG_ENABLED` 改成 `false` 即可（`console.log('[quote-pro]', …)` 会保留）。

## 发版（维护者）

发布走 **npm Trusted Publishing（OIDC）**，仓库里不保存任何 token，也不需要动态验证码：

1. 改 `package.json` 的 `version`，并在 `CHANGELOG.md` 记录变更
2. 提交、打标签、推送：

   ```sh
   git tag -a v0.2.2 -m "v0.2.2"
   git push origin main --follow-tags
   ```

3. GitHub Actions 的 [`release.yml`](.github/workflows/release.yml) 自动执行：
   校验 tag 与版本一致 → 语法与清单自检 → `npm publish --provenance`（带 SLSA 签名）
4. 该版本已存在时自动跳过，工作流可安全重跑

已在 npm 包设置页配置的 Trusted Publisher：

| 字段 | 值 |
|---|---|
| Organization or user | `zhao-guang-ai` |
| Repository | `dsh-quote-annotate-pro` |
| Workflow filename | `release.yml` |
| Environment name | `npm` |

> 注：npm 现在对"绕过 2FA 的 token 直接发布"逐步收紧（账号变更已限制，直接发布 2027-01 起限制），
> 因此本仓库从一开始就只走 OIDC —— 这是官方推荐方向，也避免了 token 泄漏风险。

## 已知限制

- **输入框 chip 本体跳转依赖 `title`**：本版本 chip 无 `data-*` 属性，是按渲染出的 `title`（= 插入时写入的 label）反查 ref；
  label 相同的多条引用只会命中最早的一条（导航条则始终精确）。
- **跳转要求原文行在当前页面**：目标消息未加载（历史未翻到）时只能给出提示，不做自动翻页加载。
- **导航条在会话切换后重建**：锚点按会话存储；切到别的会话不会串。
- **回合尾部按钮在有交付文件的回合也会显示**：上游会隐藏、让位给官方「已生成文件」chips。
- **评语以纯文本追加在 chip 之后**：编辑 chip 文本请用 Backspace 删除。

## 贡献

欢迎 Issue / PR。提 PR 前请跑一遍 `npm run check`，并说明验证时使用的 DSH 版本（本仓库在 **0.2.0-rc.2** 上真机验证）。
由于 DSH 仍处于 rc 阶段，内部契约可能随版本变化，改动请附上验证方式。

## 许可与来源

MIT，见 [LICENSE](./LICENSE)。

- 上游：[`wangwei-wade/dsh-quote-annotate`](https://github.com/wangwei-wade/dsh-quote-annotate) v0.1.1（MIT，© 2026 wangwei-wade）
- 本 fork：修复其在 **DSH 0.2.0-rc.2** 上的 6 个兼容性问题，并补充引用定位相关能力，同样以 MIT 发布

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 手机远程控制插件：扫码即用，局域网 / IPv6 / Cloudflare 隧道三通道，令牌鉴权
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-remote 🐋

> DeepSeek Harness 手机远程控制插件：扫一下二维码，用手机指挥你的 Agent。
> 局域网 / IPv6 / Cloudflare 隧道三通道，令牌鉴权，Windows 开箱即用。
>
> A remote-control plugin for DeepSeek Harness — scan a QR code and drive your agent from your phone.

[English](README_EN.md) · [使用文档](docs/USAGE.zh-CN.md) · [注意事项](docs/NOTES.zh-CN.md) · [更新日志](CHANGELOG.md)

## ✨ 功能

- 📋 **会话总览**：手机查看全部会话与实时运行状态（含子 Agent 标记）
- 💬 **对话阅读**：Markdown / 表格 / 代码块渲染，色彩突出重点；历史消息分页加载
- ✉️ **远程指挥**：给任意会话发消息（忙时自动排队）、停止任务、新建会话
- 📎 **图片与文件**：手机上传，图片自动转 JPEG 压缩；Agent 经视觉工具（modlens）读图
- 🌐 **三通道连接**：局域网直连（首选）· Cloudflare 外网隧道（HTTPS，任何网络可用）· IPv6 直连（备用）
- 🔐 **安全内置**：令牌鉴权、配对页仅限本机、隧道来源隔离

## 🌟 特色

| 特色 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 📱 手机零安装 | 只需浏览器（iOS Safari 即可），无需 App、无需公网 IP、无需升级系统 |
| 🧰 一体化配对页 | 二维码、隧道一键开关（实时日志 + 超时诊断）、视觉 Key 填写、令牌旋转——全在一个页面，不依赖插件设置页 |
| 🚀 Windows 开箱即用 | 安装包内置 cloudflared（52MB → 压缩后 18MB），打开隧道开关即可用，无需下载任何东西 |
| 🖼 纯文本模型也能看图 | 图片由 Agent 调用视觉工具读成文字证据；视觉 Key 在配对页粘贴即自动配置 |
| 🛡 防御式设计 | 服务惰性获取（开机时序安全）、错误落盘、老浏览器兼容、虚拟网卡过滤 |

## 📦 安装

### tgz 安装（推荐）

```bash
# 从 Releases 下载 dsh-remote-1.2.0.tgz，或自行打包：
pnpm pack
# 桌面端 profile
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "D:\path\to\dsh-remote-1.2.0.tgz"
# WebUI profile
npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add "D:\path\to\dsh-remote-1.2.0.tgz"
```

重启 DeepSeek Harness 后，电脑打开 **http://127.0.0.1:4666/**，手机扫码即可。

### 源码安装

```bash
git clone <仓库地址> && cd dsh-remote
pnpm install && pnpm pack   # 注意：仓库不含 cloudflared 二进制，见下方说明
```

## ⚙️ 配置后即可使用

| 配置项 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| enabled | true | 总开关 |
| port | 4666 | HTTP 服务端口 |
| bind | lan | `lan` = 0.0.0.0（手机可访问）；`loopback` = 仅本机 |
| token | 留空自动生成 | 访问令牌，内嵌在二维码链接中 |
| tunnel | false | Cloudflare 快速隧道（也可在配对页一键开启）|
| cloudflaredPath | 空 | 自定义 cloudflared 路径 |
| visionKey | 空 | 图片识别 Gemini Key（配对页填写，自动写入 modlens 配置）|

> 隧道程序：tgz / Release 已内置 Windows 版 cloudflared；**源码仓库不含二进制**（体积大），
> 源码安装用户请从 [Cloudflare 官方](https://github.com/cloudflare/cloudflared/releases) 下载放到 `~/.dsh/bin/`。
> 图片识别：需安装 [modlens](https://github.com/liustack/modlens) 视觉插件。

## 🧭 工作原理

```
┌──────────┐   QR（含令牌）   ┌────────────────────────────┐
│ 手机浏览器 │ ────────────────► │ dsh-remote 插件（DSH Host 内）│
└──────────┘    http/https     │  · 自带 HTTP 服务（默认 4666）  │
   ▲                           │  · 令牌鉴权 / 配对页本机隔离     │
   │                           │  · 惰性调用 DSH sessionController│
   └── 三通道 ◄────────────────┴────────────────────────────┘
    局域网 IP / IPv6 直连 / Cloudflare 隧道（HTTPS，任何网络）
```

## ⚠️ 已知问题（尚待修复）

| # | 问题 | 影响与规避 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 部分网络无法建立 Cloudflare 快速隧道（运营商拦截 UDP 7844 等）| 隧道卡住时配对页有日志与超时诊断；可改用局域网 / 自行搭建固定隧道 |
| 2 | 快速隧道域名随机，重连后变化 | 出门前刷新一次二维码；永久固定需自建命名隧道 + 域名 |
| 3 | 手机端不支持应答「审批 / 提问确认」| Agent 等待确认时需回电脑操作（下版本规划）|
| 4 | 无推送通知 | iPhone 锁屏后轮询暂停，解锁即恢复（下版本规划）|
| 5 | 局域网通道为明文 HTTP | 同一 Wi-Fi 内理论上可被嗅探；敏感场景请用隧道或 `loopback + 隧道` 组合 |
| 6 | 上传目录不自动清理 | 手动清理 `~/.dsh/dsh-remote-uploads/` |
| 7 | DSH 插件设置页的配置卡片在部分环境不渲染 | 已把关键配置全部搬到配对页；设置页渲染为后续优化 |
| 8 | macOS / Linux 未实测 | 移动页与核心逻辑跨平台；cloudflared 需自行下载对应版本 |

## 📌 注意事项

- **令牌 = 遥控钥匙**：拿到令牌即可控制 DSH，请勿外传；配对页与令牌旋转仅限本机访问，隧道来源被强制隔离
- **防火墙**：首次使用放行 node 入站（专用 + 公用都勾；手机热点通常算公用网络）
- **代理共存**：系统代理模式无影响；TUN 模式请将 `*.trycloudflare.com` 等设为 DIRECT
- **iPhone**：同一时间只能运行一个 VPN；iOS 18 的 Safari「不安全连接警告」会拦 http 链接（设置 → App → Safari 关闭，或直接用隧道码）；微信扫码限制 http 外链，用系统相机扫
- **隐私**：图片会发送给你配置的视觉引擎服务商；Key 只存本机（`~/.modlens/config.json`，0600）
- 完整说明见 [docs/NOTES.zh-CN.md](docs/NOTES.zh-CN.md)

## 🗂 目录结构

```
├── src/                    # 插件源码（index/plugin/server/api/settings-scope + 静态页面）
├── tools/gen-qr.mjs        # 离线二维码生成器（可选工具）
├── docs/                   # 使用文档与注意事项
├── cordis.patch.yml        # 插件行插入补丁
└── CHANGELOG.md            # 更新日志
```

## 常见问题速查

| 现象 | 处理 |
| --- | --- |
| 手机提示「仅 HTTPS」| 关闭 Safari「不安全连接警告」，或扫隧道码 |
| 页面空白 | 检查地址栏是否被改成 `https://`（删 s 重试 / 换 Chrome）|
| 只有局域网和 IPv6 码 | 点配对页「开启外网隧道」；看状态与日志 |
| 发图 Agent 读不懂 | 安装 modlens 并在配对页填视觉 Key |
| 只能看到部分消息 | 会话顶部点「↑ 加载更早的消息」|

## 许可

MIT。内置组件：[qrcode-generator](https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator)（MIT）· cloudflared（Apache-2.0，仅随 tgz/Release 分发）。

plugins.description: AI 也要下班。到点话越来越少，凌晨三点只剩一句「明天再说」；已下班照样收消息，只是只回一个「。」
plugins.readme_text:
# AI Curfew · AI 熄灯

[中文](README.md) | [English](README.en.md)

**把「AI 永远在线」拧成「AI 也要下班」。**

到点之后回复越来越短，深夜档把 `max_tokens` 从 2048 慢慢压到 64，凌晨三点只回一句「明天再说」。
高峰时段不上班、低谷时段上班；已下班状态照样收消息，但只回一个「。」。

> 卖点不是让模型**演**下班，而是**真的**下班：下班后一个 API 请求都不发 —— 0 token、0 成本、毫秒返回。

![node >=22](badges/node.svg)
![platform DeepSeek Harness](badges/platform.svg)
![dependencies none](badges/dependencies.svg)
![tests](https://github.com/qiz42144-web/dsh-ai-curfew/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)
![off-duty cost 0 tokens](badges/cost.svg)
![license MIT](badges/license.svg)

```
on-duty 上班中 ──→ winding 打烊倒计时 ──→ off-duty 已下班 ──→ lights-out 熄灯
   (满血)          maxTokens 2048→64        只回「。」        只回「明天再说。」
```

## 行为

| 时刻 | 判定 | 回法 |
|---|---|---|
| 周二 10:00 | 高峰 | `。` |
| 周二 20:00 | 低谷、未到宵禁 | 正常上班 |
| 周二 23:30 | 宵禁 winding | 短回复，预算 ≈1824 |
| 周三 01:30 | 宵禁 winding | 一句话，预算 ≈560 |
| 周三 02:30 | 宵禁 winding | 最多 20 字，预算 ≈192 |
| 周三 03:10 | 宵禁到底 | `明天再说。` |
| 周日 14:00 | 周末全天低谷 | 正常上班 |

两条独立的轴，**取谁更严谁生效**：

- **A 峰谷班表** —— 高峰不上班、低谷上班（周一至周五 9:00–12:00、14:00–18:00，扣掉周末与法定节假日）
- **B 宵禁曲线** —— 到点后预算沿锚点表从 2048 滑到 64，凌晨 3 点彻底熄灯

闸门 A 可以单独关掉，退化成纯宵禁插件。

## 安装

profile 是 DSH 里一套隔离的插件与配置环境，一台机器可以有好几套（常见的有 `desktop`、`web`、
`headless`）。把下面的 `desktop` 换成你实际在跑的那个。

**从 GitHub 装**（装了固定版本，推荐）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:qiz42144-web/dsh-ai-curfew#v0.1.0
```

末尾的 `#v0.1.0` 是 tag；去掉它就会跟着 `main` 的最新状态走。

**从本地目录装**（改这个插件本身时用）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:/绝对路径/ai-curfew
```

装好后客户端半体由 `/plugins` 提供（侧栏底部的状态胶囊 + Settings 里的班表页），Host 半体即刻生效。

## 配置

配置是 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-ai-curfew/config.json`，**改完即生效**（按 mtime 热读，不用重启）。
文件里只写你想改的键，其余走默认值：

```json
{
  "curfewStart": "23:00",
  "lightsOut": "03:00",
  "wakeUp": "09:00",
  "peakShift": true,
  "offDutyReply": "。",
  "lightsOutReply": "明天再说。",
  "debugNow": "01:30"
}
```

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | 总开关 |
| `timezone` | `Asia/Shanghai` | 班表按时区本地时间算 |
| `wakeUp` / `curfewStart` / `lightsOut` | `09:00` / `23:00` / `03:00` | 一天的四个相位，窗口可跨午夜 |
| `anchors` | 23:00→2048 … 03:00→64 | 预算锚点表，`[时刻, tokens]` |
| `curve` | `linear` | `linear`（锚点间插值） / `step`（阶梯） / `easeIn`（先稳后崩） |
| `peakShift` / `peakWindows` / `weekendValley` / `holidays` | 开 / 9-12,14-18 / 开 / 2026 表 | 峰谷闸门 |
| `offDutyReply` / `lightsOutReply` | `。` / `明天再说。` | 不请求时回什么 |
| `tiredPersona` / `tierTexts` | 开 / 四档 | 往提示词注入的疲惫档位，每四分之一窗口一档 |
| `denyToolsWhenOffDuty` | `true` | 下班后不再执行工具调用 |
| `windingReasoningEffort` | `null` | 可选：宵禁期间降到某个 reasoning effort id |
| `dryRun` | `false` | 只判定并记录，照常发请求（安全试跑） |
| `debugNow` | `null` | 时间机器：`HH:MM` 或 `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM` |
| `applyToSubagents` | `true` | 子代理是否一起宵禁；设 `false` 让派出去的活继续干完 |
| `exemptSessions` | `[]` | 豁免的会话 id，完全不干预 |
| `safetyMaxTokens` | `null` | 见下方说明，默认关闭 |

### 命令行

```
/curfew                    看班表：当前判定、预算与依据
/curfew overtime 30m       强制加班 30 分钟（宵禁暂停，期间正常上班）
/curfew off                立刻下班
/curfew auto               恢复自动班表（加班 / 强制下班 / 时间机器 全部取消）
/curfew debug 01:30        时间机器，随时试任何时段
/curfew debug clear        回到真实时间
```

命令不经过模型，所以下班状态下也能用 —— 这是「把自己关在门外」的逃生口。

**为什么是「加班」不是「请假」**：请假的主语是 AI，是它在请求不上班；但 `/curfew overtime`
实际发生的是**你命令它加班**。同理 `off` 只管「AI 下班」这一件事，不再兼职表示「宵禁关掉」。

### 关于 `safetyMaxTokens`

默认**关闭**，这是有意的。下班由 `llm/stream` 短路保证，所以第二道上限在它有用的地方都是多余的；
而在它不该管的地方反而有害 —— reasoning 模型会把很小的预算全花在思考上，于是既没有正文也没有
工具调用，供应商直接判这一轮失败：

```
Command Code reached the output token limit without producing answer text or a tool call
(finish_reason=length, max_tokens=16, outputTokens=16, reasoningTokens=16)  [OUTPUT_TOKEN_LIMIT]
```

想加一道硬上限可以自己填数字，但请按模型的**思考预算**来给，而不是按你期望的回复长度。

## 原理

下班回复走 `llm/stream` waterfall 的**短路**：直接吐一段合成的流，完全不触网。
这不是 `agent/pre-step` 的 `reject` —— 那样这一轮会彻底没有回复，用户看到的是「AI 死了」。
需求是「照样收消息，只回一个句号」，所以必须产出一条**真实的 assistant 消息**，由 agent loop 自己
组装并写入会话日志，我们只负责提供 chunk。

完整设计、踩过的坑、以及「为什么不能用 `agent/pre-step` + 手写事件」见
[`docs/architecture.md`](docs/architecture.md)；核实过的 DSH 契约见
[`docs/dsh-contracts.md`](docs/dsh-contracts.md)。

## 开发

```sh
node --test          # 零依赖；验收表就是断言
```

行为判定全是纯函数（`duty.js` / `clock.js`），所以整套班表不需要跑 Host 就能测。

徽章是**提交进仓库的本地 SVG**（`node scripts/make-badges.mjs` 重新生成），不走 shields.io ——
不依赖任何第三方服务，也不会因为图片代理不可达而裂图。只有 tests 那个是 GitHub 自己的工作流
徽章（同样在 github.com 上，不经第三方），因为它报的是**测试现在过不过**，比"用什么命令跑"有用。

CI 跑在 GitHub Actions 上：Node 22 / 24 × Linux / Windows 四个组合。因为零依赖，**没有 install
步骤**，就是 checkout + 一行 `node --test`。同一条流水线还会校验 `badges/` 与生成器一致 ——
手改徽章或改了生成器没重跑，都会红。

**改完代码要重启 DSH 才生效。** 运行中的进程按 URL 缓存插件的 ES module，停用再启用只会重跑
`apply()`，不会重新 import。`scripts/dev-reload.ps1` 用一个新 revision 目录 + 重接 junction 绕开它，
代价只要一次停用/启用。为什么 HMR 那条路走不通，也记在
[`docs/architecture.md`](docs/architecture.md#developing-against-a-running-host)。

## 状态

**尚未发布到 npm**，从 GitHub 装上就能用（见上面的安装一节）；版本 `0.1.0`。
哪些行为已经实测验收、哪些还没有，见 [`docs/acceptance.md`](docs/acceptance.md)。

## 许可与出处

MIT。峰谷口径与 2026 节假日数据的来源、署名，以及必须每年 11 月补表的维护责任，见
[`PROVENANCE.md`](PROVENANCE.md)。

plugins.description: Drive the open-source ArtCraft studio apps — PhotoCraft, FilmCraft, EffectCraft... — from DeepSeek Harness, in chat or from your own UI.
plugins.readme_text:
# ArtCraft Bridge **Drive the open-source ArtCraft studio apps — PhotoCraft, FilmCraft, EffectCraft — from DeepSeek Harness, in chat or from your own UI.** [English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) `@ninkch/dsh-artcraft` · a [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) plugin · Apache-2.0
--- ## Why this exists [ArtCraft](https://getartcraft.com/apps) is a family of **twelve** free, fair-source reinventions of Adobe's studio tools, written from scratch in pure Rust: **PhotoCraft** (Photoshop), **VectorCraft** (Illustrator), **FilmCraft** (Premiere Pro), **LightCraft** (Lightroom), **PdfCraft** (Acrobat), **EffectCraft** (After Effects), **DesignCraft** (InDesign), **WordCraft** (Word), **DeckCraft** (PowerPoint), **GridCraft** (Excel), **CADCraft** (AutoCAD) and **SoundCraft** (Pro Tools). They share one superpower that most desktop apps don't have: **every menu item, slider and dialog is a command**, and the exact same commands can be driven from a headless CLI, a JSON control channel, or an MCP server. The apps were built for agents from day one. This plugin brings that surface into DeepSeek Harness, so an AI agent can *operate* the apps — not just talk about them: - **In chat** — eight agent tools let any Harness session check the toolchain, run CLI commands, send control-channel commands to a running app, do bridged file operations, and consult a per-app capability catalog. - **In the browser** — a same-origin HTTP API (`/artcraft/api/*`) that any Harness web UI can call, no CORS, no keys. It was built for [无限画布 / infinite-canvas](../dsh-infinite_canvas/README.md), a node-based AI short-drama storyboard canvas, but any front end can use it. - **Paths belong to the caller** — this plugin is a bridge and owns no data directory. Files read or written go wherever the caller points: chat invocations default to the current conversation workspace (or any path named in the prompt); the canvas writes under its own project folder. A typical AI short-drama loop looks like this: generate storyboard frames with a model → batch color-grade and sharpen them in PhotoCraft → render an animated title in EffectCraft → assemble the final cut in FilmCraft with grading, mixing and burned-in subtitles → export H.264. Every step after "generate" runs through this plugin, headless. ## How it fits together ``` ┌──────────────── DeepSeek Harness web UI (browser) ────────────────┐ │ e.g. infinite-canvas: ① upload assets ② start jobs ③ fetch │ └─────────────────────────────┬─────────────────────────────────────┘ ▼ same-origin fetch, no CORS ┌──────────────── DSH Host · @ninkch/dsh-artcraft ────────────────┐ │ HTTP routes /artcraft/api/* + agent tools artcraft_* │ │ → child processes (the CLIs) → TCP control channel │ └──────┬───────────────────────┬───────────────────────┬───────────┘ ▼ ▼ ▼ photocraft-cli filmcraft-cli effectcraft-cli batch grading, PSD EDL/XML in-out, .ecproj (JSON) render, headless edits cut · grade · mix Lottie export └───────────────────────┴───────────────────────┘ ▼ caller-decided locations (chat → conversation workspace · canvas → its project folder) ``` Everything runs locally. No cloud round-trips, no accounts, no telemetry. ## Requirements - **DeepSeek Harness** (desktop), any platform the Harness supports. - **ArtCraft apps** — grab what you need from [getartcraft.com](https://getartcraft.com/apps) or the [storytold GitHub releases](https://github.com/storytold). The portable/installer builds ship the CLI binaries on Windows and Linux (`photocraft-cli.exe` …); macOS ships them as a separate notarized zip. Versions tested: PhotoCraft 0.6, FilmCraft 0.5, EffectCraft (early). - Nothing else. No Python, no FFmpeg — the ArtCraft apps bring their own codecs. ## Setup **1. Get the plugin onto disk** (this repository). Any folder works; keeping it inside the Harness workspace next to your other local plugins is the convention. **2. Register it with your Harness profile.** A Harness profile is a pnpm package at `C:\Users\\.dsh\profiles\\` (desktop profile by default). Two edits: ```jsonc // package.json in the profile { "dependencies": { // ...existing deps... "@ninkch/dsh-artcraft": "^0.1.1", // ← from npm // or, for local development, a link into this repository: // "@ninkch/dsh-artcraft": "link:D:/code/deepseek-plugin/dsh-artcraft" }, "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ // ...existing bundles... "@ninkch/dsh-artcraft" // ← add the name ] } } } ``` Then link and restart the Harness once (Host-side code loads at startup): ```sh pnpm install --dir C:/Users//.dsh/profiles/desktop ``` > If your Harness build ships a plugin manager UI that installs from a folder, that works too — > it ends up writing exactly the two lines above. **3. Configure** `artcraft.config.json` (copy from `artcraft.config.json.example`). Recommended location: `C:\Users\\.dsh\artcraft.config.json` (persists across plugin updates); placing it next to `index.js` also works (legacy). The file is re-read on every request — no restart needed for path changes: ```jsonc { "bins": { // three accepted forms: a directory (the -cli binary is appended), // a full path to the executable, or a bare name looked up on PATH "photocraft": "C:/craft/photocraft-0.6.0-windows-x64-portable", "filmcraft": "C:/craft/filmcraft-0.5.0-windows-x64-portable", "effectcraft": "C:/Program Files/EffectCraft" }, "control": { "filmcraft": 9876, "effectcraft": 9877 } } ``` **4. Verify.** In any Harness chat, ask your agent to run `artcraft_status`. Green lights across `bins.*.found` and you're done. ## Driving it from chat The plugin registers four tools. The agent composes them, so plain language works: > *"Color-grade every PNG in `demo/media` with a soft S-curve and smart sharpening at 80, put the > results in `demo/out/graded`."* Behind that sentence the agent will typically do: ``` artcraft_cli { bin:"photocraft", args:["batch","--actions","demo/craft/grade.json", "--in","demo/media","--out","demo/out/graded"] } ``` | Tool | What it does | |---|---| | `artcraft_status` | Toolchain health check: which of the 12 CLIs resolved, config location, control ports, running jobs | | `artcraft_cli` | Run any CLI subcommand synchronously (`photocraft-cli run/batch`, `wordcraft-cli convert`, …) | | `artcraft_control` | One command over the JSON control channel of a *running* app (filmcraft 9876 / effectcraft 9877 / vectorcraft 7979 / lightcraft 7980, or pass `port`) | | `artcraft_fs` | Bridged file ops — list / stat / read / write / mkdir at caller-decided absolute paths | | `artcraft_discover` | Family install auto-discovery: fills missing paths, auto-corrects stale ones | | `artcraft_apps` | Capability catalog for all 12 apps: CLI subcommands, control ports, MCP, repo/docs links | | `artcraft_recipes` | Built-in expert recipes: 8 cross-app professional workflows | | `artcraft_update` | The plugin's own update (check / apply) | ## Driving it from the browser Same-origin HTTP, JSON in and out. The workhorse pattern is the **job lifecycle** — start, poll, fetch — which keeps long renders off the request cycle: ``` POST /artcraft/api/job { "bin":"effectcraft", "args":["render","--comp","Main", "--out","demo/out/intro.mp4","demo/craft/intro.ecproj"], "outputs":["demo/out/intro.mp4"] } → { "id":"7f2c…" } GET /artcraft/api/job?id=7f2c…&tail=30 → { "status":"running|done|failed|timeout", "stdout":"…last lines…", "stderr":"…", "outputs":[{"rel":"demo/out/intro.mp4","exists":true,"size

plugins.description: Transparent cross-provider failover routing for DeepSeek Harness agents.
plugins.readme_text:
dsh-model-router

Transparent cross-provider failover for DeepSeek Harness.

--- Pick a model in DSH's selector as usual. When that model fails — rate limit, server error, timeout — the request moves to the next physical channel in your ordered chain and the conversation tells you what happened: the failure code, the candidate that answered, and why the switch was allowed. Models without a configured rule behave exactly as they do without the plugin. ## Install ```sh git clone https://github.com/Imzl-zl/dsh-model-router.git cd dsh-model-router npm install # DSH CLI + peers dsh plugin --profile web add packages/dsh-model-router ``` Then open **Plugins → dsh-model-router** in the web UI to configure chains per model. Config lives in the profile's patch layer and hot-reloads on save. ## Configure ```yaml enabled: true profiles: # matched by exact provider/model - id: coding-main when: { provider: deepseek-official, model: deepseek-v4-flash } candidates: # [0] is pinned to the when model - { provider: deepseek-official, model: deepseek-v4-flash, maxAttempts: 2 } - { provider: pi-ai-gpt, model: gpt-5, maxAttempts: 1, needs: { images: true } } switchOn: { rateLimit: true, server: true, timeout: true, transport: true } maxTotalAttempts: 6 default: # pure fallback pool for unconfigured models enabled: false candidates: - { provider: deepseek-official, model: deepseek-chat, maxAttempts: 1 } switchOn: { rateLimit: true, server: true, timeout: true, transport: true } maxTotalAttempts: 3 ``` ## How it works Two seams of the Agent loop, nothing else: - **`agent/request`** (`prepend: true`) picks the physical route for every attempt. It runs outside `installModelSelection`, so its override wins over the write-back of your selection — the model you picked always attempts first, and a switch never happens without a failure. - **`agent/request-error`** (inside `llm-retry`) receives the failure only when DSH's own same-route retries are exhausted, then advances the chain. Two guarantees fall out of that division: - **Two-layer budget.** Same-route retries and backoff stay owned by `llm-retry`; cross-candidate failover and the hard total cap (`maxTotalAttempts`) stay owned by this plugin. Neither layer can starve or duplicate the other. - **No blind switches.** Permanent errors (abort, auth failure, no adapter) terminate immediately. Before returning a candidate, its route config is validated through `ctx.llm.resolveCallConfig()` — the same path `selectModel` uses — so a candidate that cannot serve this exact request (e.g. the selected reasoning effort) is skipped before any call. Every route switch is folded from the durable session log into a `router/failover-history` projection, surfaced as a failover-history drawer on the config page — including through forks, where the ledger is rebuilt from the inherited prefix. ## Development ```sh npm install # repo root: DSH CLI + peers node packages/dsh-model-router/tests/unit.mjs # pure decision logic node packages/dsh-model-router/tests/run.mjs # real Loader composition npx tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck --strict --module nodenext \ --moduleResolution nodenext --target es2022 --allowImportingTsExtensions \ packages/dsh-model-router/src/index.ts ``` The composition tests boot the real headless Loader with a deterministic stub adapter and assert on the durable session log — the composition the DSH package rules require, not hand-built contexts. The web profile is verified by installing the bundle and driving the Plugins page in a browser. ## Limitations - **Agent main requests only.** Compaction and session-title calls keep their own DSH-provided configuration and are not routed. - **Tool capability is not pre-checked.** DSH exposes no machine-readable "supports function calling" metadata; a tools-incompatible candidate fails at runtime and is handled by `switchOn.invalidRequest`. - **The attempt budget has two layers.** `maxTotalAttempts` caps the attempts this plugin initiates; `llm-retry` keeps its own per-provider budget on top. - **Notices are trajectory-first.** Failover notices ride the durable log and render in the trajectory view; the chat conversation does not surface context rows in this DSH build. - **No channel health view.** The drawer shows failover history only. Design rationale, source-verified capability boundaries, and the decision register live in [`docs/design/`](docs/design/). ## License [MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: Infinite Canvas — a node-based short-drama studio plugin for DeepSeek Harness: script, multi-shot storyboard, reference-consistent assets, one-shot video generation and final cut. Local-first, bring your own models.
plugins.readme_text:
# Infinite Canvas for DeepSeek Harness **A node-based short-drama studio inside DeepSeek Harness.** Start from a one-line idea, walk out with a storyboarded, voiced, subtitled video cut — right on an infinite canvas. English | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md) ## What is this? Infinite Canvas is a [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) plugin that turns the web GUI's sidebar into a full creation studio. Instead of chat round-trips, you work the way directors do: nodes on an infinite canvas, wired into a pipeline — script, storyboard, character & scene assets, image generation, video generation, and a final cut with transitions, subtitles and dubbing. Everything runs locally in your Harness. Bring your own generation APIs, or use the built-in demo mode to learn the whole flow with zero configuration. ## How it works ```mermaid flowchart LR A[Script node
AI screenplay] --> B[Storyboard node
AI shot list] B --> C[Expand to canvas] C --> D[Multi-shot video gen
all shots in ONE prompt] D --> E[Final cut
transitions · subtitles · voices] E --> F[Export
WebM preview / FilmCraft MP4] A --> G[Reference image gen
characters · scenes · props] G --> D ``` ## Highlights ### Consistent characters, scene after scene A per-project **series bible** (style baseline + character/scene/prop cards) is injected into every AI call, so wardrobes, locations and props stay coherent across shots and episodes. After each storyboard run, a local consistency check flags any name that isn't registered yet. ### References that actually bind Reference images connect as an ordered, visible list — `[图1] 角色：Lin Ning`, `[图2] 场景：The Old House` — and that exact order is what reaches the model. Multi-character frames stay unambiguous, and Volcano Engine **Seedance**'s native `[图N]` convention is supported end to end (first frame, up to 4 reference images, official task API). ### From shots to a watchable cut **One storyboard = one multi-shot video generation.** Expanding a storyboard wires it to a single video node: every shot (order + per-shot duration) is composed into one multi-shot prompt and your video model renders the whole clip in one call — the model makes the hard cuts, no per-shot stitching seams. The **Final Cut node** then stitches segments in order — crossfade or black transitions, burned-in subtitles, original audio and TTS voices mixed in — and exports a preview cut instantly. For real post-production, one click writes a **FCP7 XML timeline + SRT** to disk and hands the render to [ArtCraft](#artcraft-bridge) (FilmCraft) for a true MP4. ### An editor-grade canvas Pan, zoom, marquee select, alignment guides, groups that fold, a minimap, 60-step undo/redo, per-node media history (last 8 results), mask-based inpainting, and middle-click everything — the canvas part should feel like an editor, not a chat sidebar. ### Bring your own models Text models come from Harness itself (no extra keys, no per-plugin parameters). Image, video and TTS backends are **multi-config** — define as many endpoints as you want, mark a default, and pick per node. Every gateway call is relayed through the local Harness host process, so **any vendor works** (no CORS headaches). No backend configured? Demo mode synthesizes placeholder images and animated videos locally so the entire pipeline is testable offline. ### A portable data root Set a **data root folder** once and everything lands there, organized by **project name**: nodes and the series bible in `project.json`, the asset index in `assets.json`, media under `image/ video/ audio/ text/`, and Craft post-production under `craft/`. Move to a new machine by copying the folder and clicking **Import from data root**. ## Quick start 1. Install the plugin (bundle folder) and restart Harness once. 2. Click the **Infinite Canvas** button in the left sidebar. 3. Add a **Script** node, type a logline, hit *AI write script*. 4. Connect it to a **Storyboard** node → *AI break into shots* → *Expand to canvas*. 5. Drop character images onto the placeholder asset nodes, hit *Run workflow*, then open a **Final Cut** node and export. > Without any generation API configured, every step runs in demo mode — the full pipeline works offline. ## Generation backends | Kind | Protocol | Notes | |---|---|---| | Text | Harness LLM service | Script & storyboard writers; pick any configured model, or override per node | | Image | OpenAI-compatible `/images/generations`, multi-reference via `/images/edits` | Size (1K/2K/4K) × ratio; mask inpainting via `edits` + PNG mask | | Video | Generic submit+poll, or **Volcano Seedance official tasks** | duration up to 15 s, 480P/720P/1080P, ratio, first frame, up to 4 reference images | | TTS | OpenAI-compatible `/audio/speech` | Per-shot voices mixed into the final cut | All gateway calls are relayed by the local Harness host process (no browser CORS limits) — any vendor endpoint with an OpenAI-style shape works. ## ArtCraft bridge When the companion [`dsh-artcraft`](../dsh-artcraft/README.md) plugin is installed, the canvas talks to the local **Craft family** (PhotoCraft, FilmCraft, EffectCraft, LightCraft, VectorCraft, DesignCraft, … — every bin the Craft suite reports, currently 12) over same-origin HTTP. Point ArtCraft's data root at the same folder as the canvas data root and all post-production lands in `projects//craft/` next to your other data: assets sync per project, images get headless PhotoCraft grading (single or batch), and final cuts export as FCP7 XML + SRT for FilmCraft to render as MP4. A status card in Settings shows one light per craft with an n/n ready summary. ## Publishing (maintainers) The maintainer runbook (red lines, branch model, versioning) lives in [`RELEASING.md`](RELEASING.md); the operations detail in [`docs/release.md`](docs/release.md); released changes in [`CHANGELOG.md`](CHANGELOG.md) — **GitHub Release notes are written in English** and copied from the changelog. Publishing runs through **npm Trusted Publishing** (OIDC) — no npm token exists anywhere: - **Release flow**: dev tested & approved → merge to `main` → create a GitHub Release (tag `v0.17.9`, …) → Actions publishes that version automatically. - The `publish.yml` workflow guards on the release commit being on `main` and the tag matching `package.json`, then publishes with a `provenance` badge. ## Data & privacy - Canvas documents, projects and settings live in browser `localStorage` (`dsh-ic:*`); asset metadata lives in IndexedDB (`dsh-infinite-canvas`) while media files persist **on disk** once a data root is set (per-project folders by project name, served by the plugin backend with HTTP Range support for video seeking). - AI text generation runs through the Harness host process (your configured models, no extra keys). - Image/video/TTS gateway calls are relayed by the local Harness host process (avoids browser CORS limits); your endpoints and keys stay local. - Nothing is uploaded anywhere by the plugin itself. ## Requirements & limitations - DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2+; demo video export needs MediaRecorder (Chromium). - The preview cut is real-time recorded WebM; for MP4 masters with multi-track editing, pair with ArtCraft FilmCraft or any NLE. - Image `edits`/mask inpainting requires a model that supports the endpoint (e.g. gpt-image-1). - Host-side plugin updates need one Harness restart; the web half hot-reloads. ## License Apache-2.0

plugins.description: Cut the input-token cost of long DeepSeek Harness sessions: source-side tool-output compression on tools/post-execute plus per-agent tool-catalogue visibility, with a measurement script.
plugins.readme_text:
v2.0.5修复了v2.0.0的source.kind为空导致dsh显示异常的问题

v2.0.3将对话框下方的页面进行了分组，使得页面看起来更加合理

v2.0.2在设置页面新增了节省token的页面
# dsh-token-frugal

Cut the input-token cost of a long DeepSeek Harness session without taking any
capability away. Three extension points, all inside the Harness event flow,
plus a panel that puts every saving under your control:

| Extension point | What it does |
|---|---|
| `tools/post-execute` | Compresses each accepted tool result before it is logged: lossless structure-aware transforms first, then a budgeted head/tail elision whose marker names a recovery path. |
| `agent/created` | Hides configured tools from one agent through `ctx.tools.restrict()` on that agent's scoped context, which the loop records as `tool-removal` / `tool-addition` blocks, and opens this conversation's section in the workspace memory document. |
| `agent/inbox/claimed` | Matches a new user message against that document and injects the best excerpts with `agent.inject()`, which appends an `agent/inbox/spliced` event rather than rewriting history. |
| `conversation.composer.dock` | The panel: the savings grouped into three grades — 初等 (lossless), 中等 (folding), 高等 (trimming and rewrites) — one switch per saving, applied to the live session and persisted next to the profile. |
| `settings.section` | The statistics page: the running and all-time record of what the savings actually removed, priced at the Harness's own 4-characters-per-token heuristic. |

**New in 2.0.0** — the saving-mode panel and the workspace memory with recall;
**new in 2.0.4** — the graded panel and the statistics page; see
[`CHANGELOG.md`](./CHANGELOG.md). Version 1.0.0's behaviour and config keys are
unchanged.

Measured on this machine over the four completed recorded sessions (149 model
requests, 8.6 M baseline prompt tokens, dominated by web-fetch, terminal, and
file-read output):

```
prompt tokens        8,624,238 -> 5,022,830   41.76%   target 40% -> MET
tool-result chars      684,300 ->   149,970   78.1%
cache-eligible       8,309,095 -> 4,841,277   41.74%
cache hit rate           96.35% ->     96.39%
```

That is the compression half alone; the memory and recall features add a small
bounded cost (at most `recall.maxChars` per matched message, zero when nothing
matches) in exchange for not re-reading the transcript.

## The saving-mode panel

A pill sits under the composer. It shows how many savings are on and opens three
grades of them, each with a switch:

```
▾ 省 Token · 已开 6/9        改动立即生效，无需重启。
  初等   只清理空白与控制符，不改变任何语义内容                      3/3  ▸
  中等   把重复行与递增计数折叠成区间，内容可无损还原                2/2  ▾
        [全部关闭]
        ● 重复行折叠   把连续重复的同一行合并为一行并标注出现次数     [switch]
        ● 递增计数折叠 把连续递增的计数折叠为「起始-结束」区间         [switch]
  高等   截断超长结果并改写模型可见内容，存在信息取舍                1/4  ▸
  完整节省统计：设置 → 省 Token 统计
  设置文件 C:\Users\you\.dsh\profiles\desktop
```

The grades are ordered by what a wrong choice costs. **初等** (`terminal`,
`columns`, `json`) is lossless by construction: it only removes whitespace,
colour, and layout that carries no meaning. **中等** (`repeatedLines`,
`numericRuns`) folds structure that the text itself encodes — a run of identical
lines, a rising counter — so the original is reconstructable from what is left.
**高等** (`elide`, `catalogue`, `memo`, `recall`) either drops content or changes
what the model is shown, and each of those carries a real trade-off. Every mode
names the exact thing it removes or folds, and says whether that is reversible,
because the switch's own label is the only documentation read before flipping it.

The card is an accordion: opening one grade closes the others, so the panel is
never taller than a single grade. Each grade carries a one-click set-all control.

Turning a switch applies it to the running session at once — no restart, and no
edit to your profile: the choice is written to `dsh-token-frugal.state.json`
beside the profile. The profile is taken from `DSH_PROFILE_DIR` (or `DSH_HOME`
plus `DSH_PROFILE`) when the harness advertises one, and otherwise discovered:
the single profile that holds this package or an earlier `dsh-token-frugal`
state file. The app process itself exports none of those variables, so the
discovery is what makes this file appear on a normal install. `catalogue` is
re-applied to agents that already exist, not only to ones created later. A mode
whose prerequisite is missing (`catalogue` with an empty `hiddenTools`) is shown
greyed and explained rather than silently doing nothing.

How it is wired, because it is the part that needed research:

- The Client half is a lazy module registered through
  `window.__ModuleLoader__.load`, whose id equals the package name. It mounts
  with `ctx.slots.inject` + `ctx.slots.register` into
  `conversation.composer.dock` for the panel and `settings.section` for the
  statistics page, and declares `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime` and
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots` in `dsh.client.inject` because the slots
  package owns those targets.
- The two halves talk over **exact HTTP routes** (`bridge.path` and its derived
  `/stats` sibling). That is not a preference: `host.call` exists only for
  sandboxed *dynamic packages*, and the Client service catalog (`layout`,
  `locale`, `sessions`, `slots`, `theme`, `timer`, `uiWorkspace`, `workspaces`)
  has no Host-facing call surface, so a profile-installed bundle needs a carrier
  the page can reach. The shipped market plugin solves it the same way.
- Visible text is pinned to Chinese by `PANEL_LOCALE` in `client.js`: the Client
  `locale` service could not be read reliably from a profile-installed bundle,
  so following it meant silently falling back to English. The English dictionary
  stays in the same table, so switching back is a one-line change. Every colour
  is a `--dsw-alias-*` theme token, so light and dark both read correctly with no
  stylesheet.

## The statistics page

Settings → 省 Token 统计 reports what the savings actually did:

```
累计节省 Token（估算）
5,120
来自被移除的 20,480 个字符（仅统计压缩）

  本次进程                历史累计
  检查过的工具结果  42     检查过的工具结果  310
  被重写的结果      35     被重写的结果      288
  被截断的结果      12     被截断的结果      97
  移除的字符数  12.0k / 40.0k      移除的字符数  88.0k / 240.0k
  节省比例          30.0%          节省比例          36.7%

按工具明细（本次进程）
工具        Token     被重写   调用次数   节省比例
read        3,000     3        3         100.0%
pwsh        1,120     8        12        40.2%

工具目录精简      2 tool(s) hidden · 每次请求约省 900 token
记忆注入次数 1    记忆注入字符数 300    原文留存失败 0
```

- **Pricing.** The Host half keeps the counters and prices them with the same
  heuristic the Harness uses to show context usage (4 characters ≈ 1 token), so
  the figure is comparable with the context meter rather than a second,
  incompatible estimate. It is a compression-only figure: it counts what the
  transforms removed, not what the model would have sent anyway.
- **Two scopes.** The current process and the all-time record are reported side
  by side, because they answer different questions — "is this working right now"
  and "was it worth installing". A two-step control clears only the all-time
  half; the running process figures stay honest.
- **The catalogue figure is per request**, not a total, and is printed that way:
  while the restriction is active, every request the agent makes is missing those
  schemas, so there is no single request to attribute it to.
- The record is persisted beside the mode state
  (`dsh-token-frugal.stats.json`), at most once every five seconds and once more
  on shutdown, so a burst of tool calls writes once. When no profile could be
  found the all-time half is kept in memory only and the page says so instead of
  pretending the total is complete. `spillFailures` counts
  results whose full text could not be stored: those are the cases where the trim
  could not name a recovery path.
- The page follows the record while it is open (a five-second refresh) and reads
  it over the derived `/stats` route, which refuses any body other than
  `{"reset": true}`.

## The workspace memory document

One markdown file per workspace, one `## session` section per conversation, one
`### ` block per recorded item:

```md
# dsh-token-frugal session memory

## session

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-client-ui-solarized-grid Solarized 配色 + 网格纸背景 + 已调优的对话气泡，给 **DSH 桌面端 / Web 客户端** 用的客户端主题插件。 - **配色**：把主题表里声明的全部 `--dsw-*` 令牌（别名层、静态色阶、Shiki 语法色）重映射 —— 浅色走 **Solarized Light**，深色走 Solarized Dark。 - **背景**：来自 blue-topaz Obsidian 网格 CSS 的"网格纸"—— 75px 主线 + 15px 细线，铺在对话滚动区（`[data-conversation-scroll]`）。 - **气泡**：浅色模式是淡青卡片（`#bfe3e0`）+ 墨色左边条（`#002b36`）；深色模式是象牙卡片（`#e8dfc9`）+ 朱橙左边条（`#ff5900`），并给卡片内文字单独压深（否则浅字浅底不可读）。 - 首次加载若系统偏好解析为深色，会**一次性**pin 成浅色（之后在 设置 → 外观 里改随时生效）。 ## 效果 | 浅色模式 | 深色模式 | | --- | --- | | ![浅色：淡青气泡卡片 + 墨色左边条，铺在网格纸上](docs/light.png) | ![深色：象牙气泡卡片 + 朱橙左边条](docs/dark.png) | | ![浅色气泡特写：3px 边条与 1px 内描边](docs/bubble-light.png) | ![深色气泡特写](docs/bubble-dark.png) | | 你会注意到的 | 具体取值与实测对比度 | | --- | --- | | **网格纸背景** | 画布 `#fdf6e3`（浅）/ `#002b36`（深）；75px 主线 + 15px 细线，`background-attachment: local` 随内容滚动，只铺在对话滚动区、不铺工具栏与侧栏 | | **正文明显变实** | 正文 `#264b55` 在画布上 **8.77:1** —— 原版 Solarized Light 的正文 `#586e75` 只有 4.99:1；次级 `#3c5b63` 6.79:1、说明级 `#586e75` 4.99:1、注脚 `#657b83` 4.13:1 | | **"我的消息"是一张卡片** | 浅色：淡青卡片 `#bfe3e0` + 左侧 3px 墨色条 `#002b36`（卡片内正文 6.88:1、边条 10.92:1）
深色：象牙卡片 `#e8dfc9` + 3px 朱橙条 `#ff5900`（卡片内文字用 scoped 深墨 `#264b55`，7.13:1；边条对画布 4.78:1、对卡片 2.37:1） | | **卡片与"纸"分得开** | 1px 内描边 `rgba(38,75,85,.2)`；卡片与画布的感知差（OKLab ΔE）：浅色 **0.098**、深色 **0.642** | | **代码块与语法色** | 201 项 `--dsw-*` 令牌全部重映射，代码块底色 `#eee8d5`（浅）/ `#073642`（深），Shiki 语法色一并走 Solarized | | **深浅不是简单反转** | 浅色是"冷青卡片 + 墨线"，深色是"羊皮纸 + 朱橙线"，两套各自成立（原因见下方设计取舍） | **已知取舍**（评审时别当成 bug）：非正文的语义色保留了 Solarized 原色 —— 例如代码块注释 `#839496` 在 `#eee8d5` 上只有 2.58:1、`state-success #859900` 2.97:1、`state-warn #b58900` 2.98:1。这是 Solarized 本身的性格（作者的设计目标是低对比、长时阅读），本主题**只压深了正文层级**，不动强调色，以免破坏语法的可辨识度。 ## 安装 ### 路线 A · 拷贝式（桌面端推荐，零依赖） 桌面端目前**没有** `dsh` CLI，也没有 npm 源可用时，用这条： ```powershell # 1) 解包/克隆本仓库到任意目录 # 2) 关掉 DSH 桌面端（让补丁在启动时被读取） powershell -File .\install.ps1 # 3) 启动 DSH ``` `install.ps1` 做两件事，都可重复执行： 1. 把 `lib/`、`package.json`、`cordis.patch.yml` 拷到 `<你的 profile>\plugins\dsh-client-ui-solarized-grid\`； 2. 幂等地往 `\cordis.patch.yml` 插入挂载行（已存在则不动），并在改动前备份该文件。 `-Profile` 默认取 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop`，多 profile 时用 `-Profile` 指定。 ### 路线 B · 原生包（有 pnpm / 自建 profile 时更干净） 本包自带挂载补丁（`dsh.bundle.patch` → `cordis.patch.yml`），所以**不需要手改任何 YAML**： ```powershell cd "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop" pnpm add github:<你的账号>/dsh-client-ui-solarized-grid # 或本地 tarball / 私有源 # 然后把包名加进 profile 的 package.json： # "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ ..., "dsh-client-ui-solarized-grid" ] } } # 重启 DSH ``` > 参考：本机已装的第三方插件 `dsh-whale-widget` 就是这个形态（`dependencies` + `dsh.profile.bundles` + 随包 `cordis.patch.yml`）。 ## 卸载 ```powershell powershell -File .\uninstall.ps1 # 移除挂载行（并可选删除插件目录） powershell -File .\uninstall.ps1 -Remove # 连插件目录一起删 ``` 路线 B 则是：从 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里去掉包名 → `pnpm remove dsh-client-ui-solarized-grid` → 重启。 ## 排错 | 现象 | 处理 | | --- | --- | | 界面毫无变化 | 确认 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里有 `ui-solarized-grid` 那一行；确认重启过 DSH（补丁只在启动时合成） | | 只有配色变了、网格没出现 | 该版本客户端的对话滚动区可能没有 `data-conversation-scroll` 属性；主题表里加一行 `data-conversation-scroll` 调试即可 | | 深色模式下气泡是浅字浅底 | 说明 scoped 深色墨规则丢了（`[data-ds-dark-theme] …{color:#264b55}`），重新构建安装 | | 想彻底恢复 | 删掉 `cordis.patch.yml` 里的挂载行 + 删除插件目录，重启 | ## 开发 / 改配色 源码结构（`lib/` 是唯一的生成产物，一并提交，便于 git 直接安装；其余文件都是手写的发布文件本身）： ``` package.json dsh.client（浏览器半边）+ dsh.bundle.patch（自带挂载补丁） cordis.patch.yml 挂载行：- insert: ui-solarized-grid / name: <包名> lib/ 生成产物：client.js（浏览器半边）、index.js（宿主半边） src/grid.css 网格 + 气泡边条/描边 + 深色墨（手写） src/client-template.js 客户端半边模板（注入逻辑） src/tokens.js 生成的 201 项令牌覆盖（由 token-sheets/ 生成） token-sheets/*.css 生成器的输入：从 DSH 安装包解出的主题样式表 tools/build-solarized-tokens.mjs 重建 src/tokens.js（16 色锚点表 S 与角色表 R 在文件顶部） tools/build-plugin.mjs 重建 lib/ tools/apply-theme.ps1 一条命令：重建 → 安装 → 自检 tools/normalize-palette.mjs 一次性：把 curated 字面量归一到 S/R（保留作溯源） tools/analyze-palette-derivation.mjs 分析每个颜色能否由 16 色推导、哪些是手工调色 tools/contrast-audit.mjs 对比度审计（WCAG 对比度 + OKLab ΔE 感知差） ``` 调这两处即可： - **换整套配色**：改 `tools/build-solarized-tokens.mjs` 顶部的 Solarized 锚点表 `S`（16 色）； - **改单个元素**：改同文件的 `R` 角色表，或 `src/grid.css` 里对应的规则（网格线、气泡边条、深色墨）。 ```powershell pwsh -File .\tools\apply-theme.ps1 # 重建 + 安装（-BuildOnly 只重建） pwsh -File .\tools\apply-theme.ps1 -BuildOnly # 只重建，不动 profile ``` ## 设计取舍（fork 前请先读） - **网格必须画在滚动区上**，不能用 `body` 背景；用 `background-attachment: local` 让网格随内容滚动。 - **气泡边条只能用 `inset box-shadow`**：它沿圆角自然收窄（弯弧）；换成 `background-image` 渐变会变成被圆角硬切的方角。 - **深色气泡必须 scoped 覆盖文字色**：气泡文字读的是全局 `--dsw-alias-label-primary`（深色下是浅色），直接改全局会把助手正文一起改坏。 - **深色边条不为了过 3:1 对比度而加深**：橙族在本主题里已被语义占用（`#cb4b16` = 警告、`#dc322f` = 错误/删除），刚过 3:1 的 `#d94800` 与警告橙只差 ΔE 0.026，加深等于把"我的消息"做成警示徽标。 ## 许可与致谢 MIT（见 `LICENSE`）；Solarized 调色板由 Ethan Schoonover 以 MIT 发布；网格 CSS 改编自 blue-topaz 的 Obsidian 片段。详见 `CREDITS.md`。

plugins.description: Browse your Tripsy trips inside a DeepSeek Harness panel: itinerary, activities, lodging, transport and expenses, with times in each item's own timezone. Read-only by design -- create and edit by asking the agent.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-tripsy

Browse your **[Tripsy](https://tripsy.app)** trips inside a DeepSeek Harness panel: itinerary, activities, lodging, transport and expenses — with the times converted into each item's own timezone.

[中文说明](README.zh-CN.md) | English

---

## What it does

A sidebar entry and a center-column page.

**＋ New trip** sits at the top of the trip list. Describe what you want in plain language — where, how long, who with, what you like — and the panel composes a detailed instruction that the agent turns into a real itinerary: the trip itself first, then activities, lodging and transport filled in day by day.

**Pick a trip** and it opens with two modules inside it:

- **行程浏览 / Browse** — a cover hero with the trip name, countdown, duration and date range; a day-grouped timeline with an icon per stop; and a cost card totalling each category from the items' own prices. Every time is rendered in its own IANA timezone.
- **AI 管理 / Manage** — describe the change you want, then press one button. The panel composes a precise instruction for that trip (id, dates and timezone included) and **sends it straight to the conversation**, so the agent starts working immediately and you watch every step. There is no prompt text to read and nothing to paste. If no conversation is open yet, the panel says so up front and the button falls back to copying the instruction.

**Your account details never reach the browser.** `/api/dsh-tripsy/health` returns only the auth summary and the account currency — not the name, e-mail or avatar the Tripsy profile carries.

```
┌ Tripsy ─────────────────────────────────┐
│ ┌ ＋ 新建行程 ─────────────────────────┐ │
│ │ 用一句话让 AI 生成行程                │ │
│ └──────────────────────────────────────┘ │
│ ┌──────────────────┬───────────────────┐ │
│ │ New York City    │ 行程浏览 │ AI 管理 │ │
│ │ 10-11 → 10-17    ├───────────────────┤ │
│ │ 东京周末         │  ╔═════════════╗  │ │
│ │                  │  ║    封面     ║  │ │
│ │                  │  ╚═════════════╝  │ │
│ │                  │  10月11日 星期日   │ │
│ │                  │  ● ✈️ LAX → JFK   │ │
│ │                  │  │ 🚗 驾车到酒店  │ │
│ │                  │  ● 🏨 Aman        │ │
│ └──────────────────┴───────────────────┘ │
└─────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:ta-www/dsh-tripsy
```

Refresh the page. **Tripsy** appears in the sidebar. The first time, click **登录 Tripsy / Sign in** — the browser opens once for the OAuth handshake, and the token then refreshes itself indefinitely.

## Trip costs, completed by the agent

Tripsy's own expense reporting needs a paid plan, so the panel works from the prices already attached to activities, lodgings and transports. The **费用概览** card in each trip sums what has a price, and **AI 计算费用** hands the agent an instruction that completes it.

The split is deliberate. Summing prices is arithmetic, so it happens on the host, exactly, once, and is tested. Estimating what has *no* price is judgement, so it goes to the agent — with the real numbers attached, and told to adopt them rather than re-estimate, to say when it is unsure instead of inventing precision, and never to assume an exchange rate. Multi-currency sums are reported per currency and never silently added together.

The card is always rendered. Keying it on a non-empty price list hid it on exactly the trips that need it most — a real imported trip has 16 items and no prices at all.

The instruction asks the agent to research each unpriced item on named platforms (大众点评 / 美团 / 抖音团购 / 小红书 domestically; Google Maps, Tripadvisor, Yelp or official pages elsewhere; 12306, 航旅纵横 or airline sites for transport), to state the source and when it was checked, and to say "couldn't find it" with a range rather than invent a precise number with a fake citation. It reports a table first and writes the prices back only once that table is confirmed, so the card then shows real totals.

The prompt also states that nothing else about the trip may be added or deleted: filling in prices is the only permitted write.

## Export to your calendar (.ics)

Each trip has **导出到日历 / Export to calendar** next to its name, and a **教程 / Guide** button that opens the import steps right there — the two halves of "get this onto my phone" are useless apart.

`GET /api/dsh-tripsy/ics?id=<tripId>` returns a `text/calendar` file:

- the trip itself as one all-day event, with the end date written exclusively (+1 day) so the last day is not lost
- every activity, lodging and transport as its own event, with `LOCATION`, `GEO`, confirmation codes, prices and notes
- items without a start time are skipped, and the count is reported in `X-Tripsy-Skipped`

**Times are absolute UTC instants, not TZID-anchored wall times.** Anchoring to a named zone is only correct when the file also carries a `VTIMEZONE` with that zone's real transitions; hand-writing those gets DST wrong and shifts events by an hour. UTC cannot be misread by any calendar and keeps flight durations truthful. The local wall time is written into each description instead, so the itinerary still reads the way the booking does.

On iPhone: save the `.ics`, then hand it to a Shortcut (the community *ICS To Calendar* one, or three actions of your own: receive Files → Choose from Calendar → Add New Event) or just tap the file and let iOS ask which calendar to use.

## How it works

The host half registers a small route family and carries its own OAuth 2.1 + MCP client in `lib/tripsy/`, so installing the plugin needs no separate service and there is exactly one implementation of the OAuth dance and one place a token is refreshed.

| | |
|---|---|
| `lib/index.js` | host half: `/api/dsh-tripsy/{health,trips,trip,login}` |
| `lib/client.js` | browser half: the sidebar row and the panel page |
| `lib/tripsy/*.mjs` | OAuth 2.1 (PKCE + dynamic client registration), Streamable HTTP MCP client |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | inserts the plugin row |

Credential at rest: `$DSH_HOME/tripsy-auth.json` (override with the `authFile` config). It is never sent to the browser — the panel only ever sees the data, never the token.

Requests are refused unless they come from loopback. Set `allowRemote: true` in the plugin config if you deliberately serve the UI over a LAN address.

## Configuration

```yaml
- id: ui-tripsy
  name: dsh-tripsy
  config:
    authFile: 'C:\Users\you\.dsh\tripsy-auth.json'   # where the token lives
    allowRemote: false                               # keep loopback-only
    enabled: true
```

## Notes

- Needs an active Tripsy account. Document attachments require Tripsy Pro; everything else works on a free account.
- Times are stored as UTC by Tripsy and rendered in each item's IANA timezone, which is what the upstream API expects clients to do.
- Unofficial community plugin, not affiliated with Tripsy.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: Three-level source-text pins for DeepSeek Harness that survive context compaction: recall on demand, resident background, or highlighted constraints.
plugins.readme_text:
# highlightpin

[![Check](https://github.com/sbearbug/dsh-highlightpin/actions/workflows/check.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/sbearbug/dsh-highlightpin/actions/workflows/check.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

**Pin any selected passage; compaction cannot take it away.**

[中文](README.zh.md) · [Design](DESIGN.md) · [Evaluation](EVAL.md) · [Live evidence](docs/PROBES.md)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) plugin. Select any stretch of text in a conversation — a constraint, a number, a formula, a piece of code — and pin it with one click. From then on, no matter how the context is compacted, what the model receives is that **source text**, not a summary.

## Three levels

Each pin carries its own level:

| Level | Behaviour | Good for | Cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| **pin** (default) | Does nothing while the text is still in context; once compaction drops it, the extract text is re-inserted verbatim near the tail before the next request | Most pins | Never touches the system prompt, so it does not break the prefix cache on its own |
| **resident** | Lives in the system prompt with neutral wording: "consult it when relevant; no need to bring it up" | Important background: you want the model to match on it the moment it matters, without you mentioning it every turn | Costs one prefix-cache invalidation when you switch levels |
| **highlight** | Lives in the system prompt with emphatic wording: "follow it when relevant; if it conflicts with your latest explicit instruction, the latest instruction wins" | Constraints and priorities the model must keep honouring | Same as above; emphasis also raises how often the model brings it up on its own |

`resident` and `highlight` are deliberately two separate levels. "The model can always find it" and "the model always keeps it in mind" are different things, and emphasis has side effects of its own — so the choice is yours.

## Installation

From npm (published releases):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-highlightpin@0.1.1
```

Or straight from the GitHub source:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add 'https://codeload.github.com/sbearbug/dsh-highlightpin/tar.gz/v0.1.1'
```

On the web profile, replace `desktop` with `web`. After installing or upgrading, **fully quit and restart DSH**, then refresh the page, so that host and client both load the new version. Existing pins survive.

### Compatible DSH versions

`peerDependencies` declares `>=0.1.7-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`. The DSH plugin manager checks these peers with `semver.satisfies(runtimeVersion, range, { includePrerelease: true })` and blocks installation and activation on a mismatch.

| DSH version | Status |
|---|---|
| 0.2.0-rc.2 | **Verified live** — development and real-machine checks both ran on this version |
| 0.1.7-rc.1 / 0.1.7-rc.2 | **Offline suite passes**; CI re-runs the same suite against this line on every push |
| Other 0.2.x | Inferred from the APIs used, not verified individually |
| ≤ 0.1.6 | **Unsupported**: `CommandDefinitionId` does not exist at 0.1.5 and below, and the 0.1.6 line's session-event validation already differs |
| ≥ 0.3.0 | Not claimed |

## Usage

1. Select text inside **one** finished user or assistant message.
2. Click the pin above the composer.
3. Click the arrow beside it to open the details panel: switch each pin between "recall / resident / highlight", check budget usage, or unpin.

When you select inside a formula, the selection is expanded to the whole formula and what gets stored is the TeX source. Select the rendered $\nabla_\theta J(\theta)$ and the plugin stores `$\nabla_\theta J(\theta)$` — not the glyphs on screen. Selections inside code keep their indentation and line breaks.

Everything is also available from the command line:

| Command | Effect |
|---|---|
| `/hlpin list` | List every pin, its level and budget usage |
| `/hlpin last` | Pin the most recent assistant reply in full |
| `/hlpin show <n>` | Show one pin's full text |
| `/hlpin drop <n>` | Unpin |
| `/hlpin level <n> pin\|resident\|highlight` | Change a pin's level |

## Design notes

- **What is stored is source text, not screen text.** The client serialises the selection first (formulas back to TeX, copy buttons and line numbers stripped out), and the host then locates the matching source substring in the session log. Alignment reports one of three fidelities: `source-exact` (a clean hit), `source-normalized` (matched after whitespace and Markdown normalisation, but still storing a source slice), or `rendered` (no match — it stores the display text and **tells you so**).
- **`pin` only re-inserts after the original is gone.** Right after pinning, the text is already in context, so re-injecting it would be pointless. It comes back only once compaction has shadowed it — and at that moment the prefix cache was already invalidated. So the default level cannot break caching by construction.
- **The decision is a pure function that keeps no ledger.** Every step re-decides from "is this text still in context", and records nothing like "already re-inserted". A rejected step, a plugin restart, or the recall notice itself being compacted later therefore cannot lose a pin.
- **The resident section and the recall notice never duplicate each other.** Each step records which pins actually went into the system prompt for that step, and the recall path excludes them. With no such record it re-inserts as usual: better to duplicate than to lose.
- **Over budget means rejection, not truncation.** `pin`, `resident` and `highlight` each have their own character pool. Adding or promoting past a pool's budget is rejected outright with an error code; demotion is always allowed. The plugin never quietly truncates, evicts, or demotes a pin.
- **The session log format is left alone.** Pins live in the official `storageDomain`, and recall uses a message type the host already has, so a session can never become unloadable from an unknown event. The HTTP API is origin-checked and accepts JSON only from the local page.

The full set of trade-offs is in [DESIGN.md](DESIGN.md).

## Verification status

- **Live**: "pin → `/compact` → next message" has been run end-to-end in DSH. The shadowed source text appeared in the next request's input, byte-identical to what was stored, with a matching SHA-256. Evidence: [docs/PROBES.md](docs/PROBES.md) and [docs/m1-live-0.1.4.json](docs/m1-live-0.1.4.json).
- **Offline**: alignment, selection serialisation, the decision function, all three injection paths, budgets, routes, commands and React interaction are covered by tests, run by CI on every push.


## Configuration

```json
{ "maxPinChars": 16000, "maxResidentChars": 6000, "maxHighlightChars": 2000, "holdSubagents": false }
```

| Setting | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `maxPinChars` | 16000 | Total source characters across `pin` pins |
| `maxResidentChars` | 6000 | Total source characters across `resident` pins |
| `maxHighlightChars` | 2000 | Total source characters across `highlight` pins |
| `holdSubagents` | `false` | Whether subagent sessions are covered too (off by default, to avoid wasting tokens) |

Characters are counted in UTF-16 units. Neither the number of pins nor the length of a single pin is capped; only the total per level is.

## Limitations

- Selections must stay within a single message; cross-message selections are not supported.
- Streaming messages, reasoning content and tool output are not supported.
- Pins belong to one session; forked sessions do not inherit them.
- One writer host per profile is supported.
- "Highlight" here is an emphasis level in the model input; it does not draw a visual highlight on the original message.


## Development

```sh
npm ci
npm run check   # build the client + run all tests + loader check
npm run eval    # controlled fixture: byte-exact preservation through all three levels
```
