plugins.readme_text: # @xsj/dsh-favourite DSH 收藏插件：为工作区管理侧栏（`sidebar.workspaces`）增加会话/工作区收藏、收藏筛选、置顶展示与 fork 收藏继承，另提供可配置的收藏星标颜色。 > A DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds favorites (star) for sessions and workspaces, a favorites-only filter, a "hide unfavorites" display mode, top-pinning with hover metadata, star-color settings, and fork-time favorite inheritance. ## 界面预览 | 全部显示 | 只看收藏 | 隐藏未收藏 | |---|---|---| | | | | | 视图选项 · 星标颜色 | 置顶行悬浮元信息 | |---|---| | | | ## 功能 1. **收藏**：工作区行与会话行悬停出现星标按钮（收藏后常亮）；行菜单里也有 收藏/取消收藏。收藏工作区**不会**自动收藏其内部会话。 2. **只看收藏**（筛选收藏结果）：一级只显示 **收藏的会话（散行，不带工作区归属）+ 收藏的工作区**；收藏的工作区可展开，展开显示其下**全部会话**；未收藏的工作区与未收藏的会话不出现。散行排序跟随视图选项的 排序方式（最近更新=按活跃度，手动=跟随单列表手动顺序）。 3. **置顶**：对收藏的会话/工作区执行 置顶（行菜单），置顶项显示在工作区管理最上方。置顶会话以单行形式直接展示，**不显示工作区名**；鼠标悬浮展示工作区名、路径、会话标题、时间与状态等元信息。置顶为额外快捷行，**会话本身仍保留在其工作区内**，不改拓扑。 4. **fork 继承**：会话 fork 时（`session/created`，普通 fork 而非子代理），子会话默认继承原会话当时的收藏与置顶状态。 5. **隐藏未收藏**：官方结构上只做减法 —— 不显示"未收藏工作区的未收藏会话"：收藏的工作区展开显示其**全部**会话；未收藏但含收藏会话的工作区显示且会话嵌在其中；收藏会话数为 0 的未收藏工作区隐藏。 6. **全部显示**：官方原样列表（显式回落入口，取消任一筛选也可回落）。 7. **在文件资源管理器中打开工作区**：置顶行与散行的菜单项 —— 打开会话所属工作区目录的资源管理器窗口并**聚焦**（Windows 经 Shell.Application COM + AppActivate，规避分离式启动不抢前台的问题）。 8. **散行拖动排序**：只看收藏的散行支持长按拖动，与官方单列表共用同一份手动顺序。 9. **星标颜色**：视图选项菜单可选 金黄/橙/红/蓝/紫/跟随主题，持久化保存。 两个筛选/隐藏模式激活期间**跳过 5 行折叠限制**（普通浏览时超过 5 个会话折叠为"展开其余 N 个"，筛选模式下匹配项永不折叠隐藏）。收藏文档 2 秒轮询 + 窗口聚焦即时刷新，多窗口/宿主侧 fork 继承最迟 2 秒可见。 置顶行菜单同时提供 重命名 / 分叉会话 / 归档会话，行为与组内会话行一致。 ## 安装 ```powershell # 从 GitHub 安装 dsh plugin --profile web add github:XSJUSTC/dsh-favourite # 或从本地目录 dsh plugin --profile web add <本插件目录或 file:/link: 路径> # 重启 DSH，刷新页面 ``` 安装后插件以 `priority: -1` 影子接管 `sidebar.workspaces` 槽位（官方浏览器保持注册，卸载本插件即回落）。 ## 数据与接口 - 持久化：`/storages/dsh-favourite.json`（原子写） - 路由：`GET /api/dsh-favourite`、`POST /api/dsh-favourite/toggle`、`POST /api/dsh-favourite/pin`（64KB body 上限） - 宿主服务：`ctx.dshFavourite`（snapshot / toggle / setPinned / isFavorited） - fork 继承：监听 `session/created`，`header.parentSession` 且 `isSeeded` 且非 `subagent` 时继承 ## 结构 ``` lib/index.js 宿主半：路由、存储、fork 继承 lib/client.js 客户端半：影子注册的收藏版 WorkspaceBrowser cordis.patch.yml 挂载行 ``` ## License MIT

plugins.description: DSH 工作区长期记忆插件：会话开始注入记忆摘要、memory 工具按需读写、轮次结束自动提炼，设置面板里可查看与管理；支持把 Qoder / WorkBuddy 的既有记忆导入。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-memory

[![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/BangBang-03/dsh-memory?color=4d6bfe&label=release)](https://github.com/BangBang-03/dsh-memory/releases/latest)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/BangBang-03/dsh-memory?color=4d6bfe)](https://github.com/BangBang-03/dsh-memory/blob/main/LICENSE)
[![Tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/tests-311%20passed-4d6bfe)](https://github.com/BangBang-03/dsh-memory#测试)

DSH 的**工作区长期记忆**插件。对标 Qoder / WorkBuddy / ZCode 的记忆交互：记忆以当前工作区为单位落库，
会话开始时把最重要的几条以**索引**形式注入系统提示（一行一条，正文按需用 `memory` 工具取，省 token），
模型可以随时读写，轮次结束后把与当轮话题相关的记忆**召回**进下一轮，还可以（可选）自动提炼——
提炼结果可以直接落库，也可以先进**待审队列**由你批准。全部记忆都能在 **设置 → 记忆** 里管理：
记忆库（档案 / 列表）、时间线、健康体检、审批队列。

- 宿主半 `lib/index.js`：系统提示注入（索引/全文双模式）、轮末相关召回、`memory` 工具、`/memory/api` 路由、轮次结束自动提炼。
- 客户端半 `lib/client.js`：设置面板里的「记忆」页，四个 tab——**记忆库**（档案 / 列表两视图；档案有整篇文档（ZCode 式索引）/ 按标签 / 按类型 / 时间线四种排布，顶部带「刚刚记了什么」变化横幅与「下次会话将注入」预览）、**维护**（体检 + 待审队列 + 标签清理）、自动提炼、设置。
- 纯逻辑层：`lib/store.js`（存储）、`lib/distill.js`（提炼）、`lib/api.js`（HTTP 契约），都不依赖 DSH，可独立测试。

## v0.3.0「百家记忆」：借鉴了谁

| 来源 | 机制 | 本插件的落点 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ZCode / Qoder | `MEMORY.md` 一行一条索引常驻，正文按需读取 | `briefMode: index`（默认）——简报只注入「标题 + 标签 + id」，同样字数预算下能装约 3 倍的条目，注入量降 60–70%；模型用 `memory get/search` 按需取全文 |
| ZCode | 每轮后台召回相关记忆（已召回快照防重复） | `turnRecall`：轮次结束后拿当轮用户消息做本地检索，命中的记忆下一轮随简报注入「相关召回」块；连续两轮不重复，纯本地打分零模型开销 |
| ZCode | 类型体系（feedback/user）+ Why/How to apply | 新增 `feedback`（协作纠正/肯定，提炼时按「规则 + Why + How to apply」组织正文）与 `user`（用户画像，强制全局）类别 |
| ZCode | `[[related]]` 双链（悬空允许）、验证式过期 | 记录可带 `related` 关联；简报页脚固定提示「引用记忆里的路径/函数前先验证还存在」；体检列出待验证项 |
| Qoder | 自动整理沉淀、版本回滚、可控写入 | 体检（重复簇/过期未用/断链）一键处理；`supersedes` 版本链——推翻不删除，旧条归档可一键回滚；`captureMode: draft` 提炼结果先进审批队列 |
| WorkBuddy | 三层记忆（工作/知识/持久）、记忆管理面板 | 全局 / 工作区 / 会话召回三层在 UI 全景呈现；时间线视图 + 健康面板（KPI、token 估算、问题清单） |
| Hindsight | 推翻不删除；引用署名 | supersede 版本链天然满足；简报与工具返回都带 id，模型可标注「（记忆 #id）」 |

## 记忆存在哪

```
~/.dsh/storages/dsh-memory/
  index.json                     工作区索引
  settings.json                  面板里改的设置（cordis config 只是初值）
  workspaces/<目录名>-<hash>/memories.json    每个工作区一个库
  workspaces/<目录名>-<hash>/MEMORY.md        这个库的人读旁车（始终写）
  workspaces/_global/memories.json            跨工作区共享的全局记忆
```

工作区目录名带 8 位 hash（`workspaceKey()` 取规范化路径的哈希），所以同名目录不会互相污染。
记忆默认**不落在仓库里**，不随 git 外泄；需要人类可读的副本时打开 `mirror`，会在工作区写
`<工作区>/.dsh-memory/MEMORY.md`（Markdown，可以直接提交也可以 `.gitignore` 掉）。工作区目录
不存在时这一份会被跳过，绝不凭空造目录；把 `mirror` 关掉会把已生成的那份撤掉（空目录一并收走）。

一条记忆长这样：

```json
{
  "id": "…",
  "title": "插件安装方式",
  "content": "package 进入 dsh.profile.bundles 后，其 cordis.patch.yml 会被自动应用。",
  "category": "convention",
  "tags": ["dsh", "plugin"],
  "keywords": ["插件", "安装", "bundle"],
  "related": [],
  "supersedes": null,
  "supersededBy": null,
  "status": "active",
  "scope": "workspace",
  "source": "manual",
  "files": [],
  "createdAt": "2026-10-10T…",
  "updatedAt": "2026-10-10T…",
  "lastUsedAt": null,
  "useCount": 0,
  "seenCount": 0,
  "pinned": false,
  "archived": false,
  "confidence": 1
}
```

类别：`fact` 事实、`preference` 偏好、`decision` 决策、`convention` 约定、`component` 组件、
`task` 待办、`note` 笔记、`feedback` 反馈（协作纠正/肯定）、`user` 用户画像（强制全局，跟着人走）。
来源：`manual` 手工 / `agent` 模型调用工具 / `auto` 自动提炼 / `import` 导入。
`status: "draft"` 的记忆是待审草稿：不进简报、不进检索、不进镜像，批准后才生效。

版本链：`save` 带 `supersedes`（或自动提炼识别出「情况已变」）时，新条生效、旧条归档并互指，
面板里可以一键**回滚**——推翻不删除，历史一直在。

## 四条记忆通路

1. **会话开始注入索引**（`briefing`）。系统提示里多一段 `dsh-memory:workspace-briefing`
   （order 550，夹在 PLAN_POLICY 500 与 TEAM_POLICY 600 之间）。默认 `briefMode: index`——
   一行一条「📌 [类别] 标题 #标签 (id)」，正文不展开；切 `full` 则回到标题+正文摘录的旧形态。
   两种模式都受 `briefingLimit` / `briefingMaxChars` 双重限制，页脚写明「正文按需取 + 引用前先验证」。
   工作区从 `context.agent.session.header.cwd` 现取，切换会话即切换记忆。
2. **`memory` 工具**。模型可以 `save` / `search` / `list` / `get` / `update` / `forget` / `stats`。
   保存时先做一次相似度探测，超过 0.72 就合并进已有那条（`dedupe` 可关）；带 `supersedes` 时走版本链；
   `related` 把同主题的记忆串起来（允许悬空）；`keywords` 提升检索命中。
3. **轮末相关召回**（`turnRecall`，默认开）。监听 `session/event` 的 `turn/end`，拿当轮最后一条用户消息
   做一次本地打分检索，命中的记忆（排除已在简报与上轮已召回的）下一轮以「相关召回」块注入，并计一次使用。
   纯本地计算，不花模型 token；`turnRecallLimit` 控制每轮条数。
4. **轮次结束自动提炼**（`autoCapture`，默认关）。把最近一段对话交给同一路由的模型归纳成结构化记忆，
   按 `minConfidence` 过滤。`captureMode: direct`（默认）直接落库；`captureMode: draft` 先落草稿进
   **审批队列**，面板批准（可顺手改）后才生效——草稿若挂着 `supersedes`，批准即兑现版本链。
   刻意**不**监听 `agent/turn-stopping` —— 那个事件是串行 await 的，长活在它里面会拖住轮次收尾。

## 安装

`dsh plugin --profile desktop …` 会被拒绝（`profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the
Electron application`），所以手工装。**改 profile 文件前先备份** —— 脚本已经帮你备份（带秒级
时间戳，同一秒内多次改动往后编号，绝不覆盖旧备份）。

```powershell
cd <克隆下来的 dsh-memory 目录>
pwsh -File install.ps1 -DryRun     # 先看一眼要改什么
pwsh -File install.ps1             # 真装
# 重启 DSH 桌面端
```

不想 clone 也可以直接下 [Releases](https://github.com/BangBang-03/dsh-memory/releases/latest)
里的 `Source code (zip)`，解压后同一个目录结构、同样跑 `install.ps1`。

回滚：

```powershell
pwsh -File uninstall.ps1                 # 卸插件，记忆数据保留
pwsh -File uninstall.ps1 -PurgeStorage   # 连 ~/.dsh/storages/dsh-memory 一起删
```

脚本做的三步（也就是手工安装的三步）：

1. 包放进能解析 `@deepseek-ai/*` 的位置。用 junction 挂载时 Node 会按 realpath 解析，
   源码目录向上找不到 profile 的 `node_modules`，因此包内需要一层垫片：

   ```powershell
   # $repo = 你克隆下来的 dsh-memory 目录
   New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path "$repo\node_modules\@deepseek-ai" `
     -Target "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\node_modules\@deepseek-ai"
   ```

2. 在 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json` 里加两处（都用**真包名**）：
   - `dsh.profile.bundles` 数组加一项 `@bangbang-03/dsh-memory`
   - `dependencies` 加 `"@bangbang-03/dsh-memory": "link:<$repo 的绝对路径，正斜杠>"`

   进了 `dsh.profile.bundles` 之后，包自己的 `cordis.patch.yml` 会被自动应用，
   **不需要**改 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`。写盘走「临时文件 + 替换」，不直接覆写。

   > ⚠️ **依赖键、bundles 项、`cordis.patch.yml` 的 `name`、客户端模块 id 必须是同一个真包名**
   > （= `package.json` 的 `name`）。客户端半的浏览器模块按 manifest 包名认领，写成别名时宿主半
   > 照常工作、设置面板里的界面却**整块消失**（0.3.2 改包名时踩过，0.3.4 修）。`install.ps1`
   > 会自动把 0.3.2 之前的老别名 `dsh-memory` 迁移掉。

3. 建 junction：

   ```powershell
   New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\@bangbang-03\dsh-memory" `
     -Target $repo
   ```

4. 重启 DSH 桌面端（新增 loader 行需要重启宿主；之后改客户端半硬刷新即可）。
   卸载脚本只删 junction 与清单项；碰到不是 junction 的同名路径会直接报错退出，不会误删真实目录。

打开 **设置 → 记忆**（导航 order 25）就能看到。宿主路由是 `/memory/api`，客户端一律以
`new URL("memory/api/…", document.baseURI)` 解析，反代目录前缀和 `dsh-app://` 外壳下都能到达。
非回环来源会被 403 拒绝。

## npm 包与远程更新

包以 **`@bangbang-03/dsh-memory`** 发布（`dsh-memory` 裸名在 npmjs 已被他人占用）。发布位置是
**GitHub Packages**（`npm.pkg.github.com`）——npmjs.org 在部分网络环境下不可达，GitHub 这条
通路用现有的 GitHub 凭据即可发布与安装。等 npmjs 可达后，同一份代码 `npm publish --access public`
就能再发一份公共包（`prepublishOnly` 会先跑全量测试）。

### 远程安装 / 更新（不再需要本地克隆）

```powershell
# 方式一：Release 资产直连（公开、零凭据，推荐）。
# 每次发版都会上传固定名资产 dsh-memory-latest.tgz，/latest/download/ 永远指向最新版：
pwsh -File install.ps1 -FromUrl "https://github.com/BangBang-03/dsh-memory/releases/latest/download/dsh-memory-latest.tgz"

# 方式二：走 GitHub Packages 的 npm registry（需要带 read:packages 的 PAT）
pwsh -File install.ps1 -FromNpm "@bangbang-03/dsh-memory" `
  -Registry https://npm.pkg.github.com -NpmToken $env:NPM_TOKEN

# 锁版本用 -FromNpm "@bangbang-03/dsh-memory@0.3.2"；-DryRun 只打印计划，不联网不落盘
```

`-FromNpm` 会把包的 tarball 拉下来解包到 `~/.dsh/plugins/dsh-memory`，然后对它执行与本地安装相同的
三步（垫片 / profile 清单 / junction）。**更新就是重跑同一条命令**：脚本会整体替换 plugins 里的旧版本，
junction 与 profile 引用的目录名不变，DSH 侧不需要任何动作；想锁版本就在包名后带 `@0.3.1`。
`-DryRun` 只打印计划，不联网不落盘。替换旧版本时脚本会先摘掉目录内的垫片 junction 再删
（PowerShell 5.1 的 `Remove-Item -Recurse` 会跟进 junction 删到共享模块里，这一步是防它的）。

卸载（`uninstall.ps1`）只拆 junction 与 profile 清单项，`~/.dsh/plugins/dsh-memory` 会保留
（想彻底清掉手动删即可），记忆数据依旧只随 `-PurgeStorage` 删。

### 发布新版本（维护者）

```powershell
npm publish --registry https://npm.pkg.github.com --access public
# 凭据：把带 write:packages 的 PAT 写进 ~/.npmrc 的 //npm.pkg.github.com/:_authToken，
# 或临时用环境变量注入，不要把 token 提交进仓库。
```

## 档案（默认视图）

面板默认是**档案**视图，形状照着 WorkBuddy 的「记忆与进化」页做。它只有一样东西：
**一个工作区一份长记忆**——正文是连续文档，由对话里的 `memory` 工具维护，用户不需要在这里逐条新建、
也不需要理解「条数」。

同一个视图有四种排布，用右上角的下拉切换（默认是 `整篇文档`）：

| 排布 | 长什么样 | 什么时候用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **整篇文档** | ZCode 式索引：一条 `▾ 标题 + 一句话钩子`，点开看全文（索引常驻、正文按需） | 平时看/改「这个工作区记住了我什么」 |
| **按标签分组** | 每个分区里按标签归类成一叠可折叠的组（大小写变体自动归并显示），没有标签的落进「未归类」排在最后 | 散条目多，想按主题收拢 |
| **按类型分组** | 同上，但按 `category`（事实/偏好/决策/约定/组件/待办/笔记）

plugins.description: Free OpenCode Zen models for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) — native dsh-llm adapter, no API key. Fork with muse-spark unblocked, xhigh/max thinking levels, and a session-log safety guard.
plugins.readme_text:
# opencodezen4dsh **Free OpenCode Zen models, natively inside DSH (DeepSeek Harness).** No API key. No registration. No extra process. [![release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/defaver04/opencodezen4dsh?label=release)](https://github.com/defaver04/opencodezen4dsh/releases) [![license](https://img.shields.io/github/license/defaver04/opencodezen4dsh)](./LICENSE) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A520-brightgreen)](https://nodejs.org) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-blue)](https://github.com/defaver04/opencodezen4dsh) [![tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/tests-266%2F266%20pass-brightgreen)](./CHANGELOG.md) English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
--- > **opencodezen4dsh** is a maintained fork of > [FishBottle7/opencode2dsh](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh) > (upstream 0.3.11, MIT), developed at > [defaver04/opencodezen4dsh](https://github.com/defaver04/opencodezen4dsh). > It keeps the upstream's native-adapter architecture and adds three > fork-owned improvements — see > [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md#0311-fork2-2026-10-13--local-fork) > (fork.2) and > [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md#0311-fork1-2026-10-13--local-fork) > (fork.1): > > 1. **`xhigh` and `max` thinking levels for every reasoning model.** > `reasoningEfforts()` unions the models.dev-declared ladder with > `FORCED_EFFORT_LEVELS = ['xhigh', 'max']`, so models whose metadata > declares no ladder (`big-pickle`, `mimo-v2.6-flash-free`, …) or a short > one (`step-5-preview-free`, `muse-spark-*-contributor-free`) no longer > hide levels the Zen gateway accepts (`reasoning_effort: max` and > `reasoning.effort: xhigh` both answer 200 live). > 2. **`muse-spark-1.2-contributor-free` and `muse-spark-1.3-contributor-free` > are unblocked.** The `403 RegionError` recorded upstream in issue #56 > does not reproduce from every exit IP; both ids answer HTTP 200 on > `POST /zen/v1/responses`, so they are back in the picker (7 → 9 exposed > models on the live catalog). Still blocked, with re-probe evidence: > `jev-1.13-free` (400 `ModelProtocolUnsupported`, SystemOne-only), > `exo-free` and `ling-3.0-flash-fin-free` (gone from `GET /v1/models`). > 3. **Identity-less tool calls can no longer corrupt the session log > (fork.2).** When a free-lane model answers a tool turn with a > text-shaped `` imitation instead of a native > call, pi-ai assembles an `id:""/name:""` tool call that used to be > persisted verbatim — poisoning the whole history (`tool call id > requires a nonempty string`, session unopenable). Such calls are now > demoted to text with their arguments preserved, so the turn continues > instead of corrupting the log. > > Install from a build artifact instead of patching by hand: > > ```sh > # from this repo (builds lib/ via prepack) > git clone https://github.com/defaver04/opencodezen4dsh.git && cd opencodezen4dsh/packages/plugin > pnpm install && pnpm pack > dsh plugin --profile web add ./opencodezen4dsh-dsh-plugin-.tgz > ``` > > or grab the `.tgz` attached to the latest **Release** (the `release` > workflow runs typecheck + the full test suite, packs, and uploads it). > After installing, restart `dsh web` — Cordis imports plugin modules once > per process, so a picker refresh alone never picks up a new bundle. --- opencodezen4dsh registers a native DSH `LlmAdapter` that streams directly from [OpenCode Zen](https://opencode.ai/zen)'s **anonymous free lane** — the same models OpenCode's own CLI uses without an account, served to your DSH model picker as a regular provider called `opencodezen4dsh`. Requests leave your machine looking exactly like traffic from the OpenCode CLI (same user agent, same correlation headers), and the model catalog stays fresh through a three-tier fallback chain. There is nothing to log into and nothing to host. ## Highlights - **Zero credential, zero setup** — the anonymous lane needs no key; install, restart, chat - **Native adapter, no sidecar** — one npm package, no child process, no binary, no local port (the legacy Go sidecar is not part of the published package; see `legacy/`) - **CLI-identical disguise** — requests carry the OpenCode CLI user agent and its session/request/project header set, derived per conversation - **Selectable thinking levels** — reasoning-capable free models expose an effort picker in DSH's model selector (declared ladders where the model metadata provides them, Off/Minimal/Low/Medium/High otherwise, plus `xhigh`/`max` forced by this fork); Responses-only `muse-spark-*` models expose only upstream-supported effort levels, and no selection keeps the provider default - **Image input where it is declared** — image attachments are accepted for every model whose [models.dev](https://models.dev) entry lists `image` in `modalities.input`, and refused for the ones that declare `text` only; models.dev being silent falls back to the live-verified vision family - **Live catalog with a fallback chain** — live upstream list ∩ free-by-metadata, falling back to offline cache and a verified static list - **Self-healing** — fast startup retries, periodic refresh, and a written health snapshot for diagnostics - **Proper error surfaces** — upstream failures (rate limit, auth, timeout, transport) arrive in DSH as classified finish reasons, and retries stay owned by DSH - **Session-log safe** — identity-less tool-call lapses from free-lane models are demoted to text instead of poisoning the durable history (fork.2) ## Install **From the plugin market** (recommended, once this repo is listed there): in DSH open **Settings → Plugin Market**, search `opencodezen4dsh`, one-click install. **From a GitHub Release** (recommended today): ```sh # download the .tgz attached to the latest Release, then: dsh plugin --profile web add ./opencodezen4dsh-dsh-plugin-.tgz ``` **From source** (build the tarball yourself): ```sh git clone https://github.com/defaver04/opencodezen4dsh.git cd opencodezen4dsh/packages/plugin pnpm install && pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile web add ./opencodezen4dsh-dsh-plugin-.tgz ``` **Verify**: restart `dsh web`, open the model picker, and pick a model from the **opencodezen4dsh** group. Requires DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 0.1.7 or newer with a web profile (the IP 池 settings page rides the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract); Node.js ≥ 20 (already present if DSH runs); outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` and `models.dev`. ## Configuration Defaults work out of the box. Override via the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - id: opencodezen4dsh name: '@opencodezen4dsh/dsh-plugin' config: mode: adapter # adapter (default) | sidecar providerId: opencodezen4dsh refreshSeconds: 300 # catalog refresh cadence ``` | Option | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | `mode` | `adapter` | `adapter`: native LlmAdapter streaming straight from Zen. `sidecar`: legacy local-agent mode, not bundled — build the agent from `legacy/agent` and pass `agentPath`. | | `providerId` | `opencodezen4dsh` | Provider name shown in DSH. | | `refreshSeconds` | `300` | Live catalog refresh interval. Pricing metadata refreshes every 24 h. | | `agentPath` | auto-resolved | Sidecar only: path to the agent binary. | | `agentArgs` | — | Sidecar only: extra CLI args for the agent. | | `restartDelayMs` / `restartMaxDelayMs` / `maxConsecutiveCrashes` | `1000` / `60000` / `5` | Sidecar only: restart backoff and circuit breaker. | | `firstEventMs` / `bodyIdleMs` / `responsesBodyIdleMs` | `30000` / `120000` / `300000` | Adapter only: stream-liveness watchdogs, in ms (integers from `1` to `600000`). Time to the first stream event, mid-response body silence, and the body-idle floor for Responses models (`muse-spark-*`). Increase `firstEventMs` for slow cold starts. Unset keeps the defaults; restart DSH after editing. | ## How it works ``` DSH session │ harness chunks (block-start / text-delta / usage / finish …) ▼ ZenAdapter (registered LlmAdapter) │ pi-ai openai-completions stream (chat models) │ pi-ai openai-responses stream (`

plugins.description: DSH 本地 Token 用量统计与模型分析，支持热力图、自定义日期和模型筛选。
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Token 用量统计

在 DSH 设置中查看真实 Token 消耗、缓存命中、活动热力图和模型分布。仅显示用量，不估算费用。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:xgxx666/dsh-clear-usage
```

适用于 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` 及更高兼容版本的 Web profile。

## 使用位置

- 输入框下方完全使用 DSH 原版状态栏及详情弹窗，插件不再替换这部分界面。
- 设置 → 用量统计：查看今天、本月、全部的用量，紧凑热力图和按模型分组的列表。
- 今天：显示 24 小时用量柱状图，悬停或键盘聚焦可查看每小时 token 和调用次数；构成条展示未缓存输入、缓存读取、输出，有缓存写入时也会显示。小时分布按本地时间的调用结算时刻归档，不把跨小时调用的用量平均拆分。
- 自定义：选择开始和结束日期后点击「查询」，包含首尾两天。
- 本月、全部和自定义范围使用热力图，打开或切换时间范围时自动定位到最近日期；悬停显示日期和简写 token 数量的两行深色提示。模型用量以居中的圆环图显示，圆心展示总 token，下方颜色图例显示各模型的用量、类型和占比。
- 模型用量默认使用原模型名；在页面底部展开「模型类型」可设置显示名称。未选择类型的标签可点击跳转到该模型的本地/API选项。类型和显示名称自动保存，仅影响筛选与展示。删除后从管理列表、模型用量列表和圆环图隐藏；圆环总量与占比按当前显示的模型重新计算。页面顶部历史总用量和活动图保留完整记录，不删除 DSH 模型配置或会话日志；可在「已删除的模型」里恢复。
- 本地和 API 模型都只显示 token，不显示金额，不需要填写单价。

## 数据口径

token 来自已结算调用的真实 usage。重试单独累计；同一次调用的更新覆盖旧样本；思考 token 已含在输出内，不重复加总。历史统计排除会话分支的继承前缀，防止重复计算。缓存未报告或记录不完整时明确提示。

插件只注册设置页。输入框用量、速度和点击详情均由 DSH 原版提供。

缓存命中率采用官方口径：缓存读取 ÷（未缓存输入 + 缓存读取 + 缓存写入）。官方未提供缓存读取时按原生零值处理；插件不根据推理引擎的 KV 内存复用猜测缓存 token。

首次读取历史时最多并行处理四个会话，并按会话版本复用已有统计。再次打开页面会立即显示本次应用运行中缓存的快照，同时后台更新并标记「正在更新用量」；读取失败时保留已有数据。切换模型类型、时间范围或日期在界面内立即筛选，不再重复扫描历史；点击刷新也可获取最新用量。

当前页面不显示金额，也不需要维护供应商单价。

## 开发检查

在本目录运行：

```powershell
npm test
npm run check
```

## 本地安装

DSH 桌面版的插件页也可以选择本项目目录进行本地安装。本包不包含依赖安装脚本，不需要 API 密钥。

模型分类保存在 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-clear-usage/models.json`。已有配置的旧字段保留以兼容历史版本，但页面不再提供单价输入或金额显示。不读取密钥、不发送消息正文、不访问供应商接口。

## 隐私与数据

用量从 DSH 本地会话记录读取，消息正文不会离开 DSH。插件不读取凭据、不调用供应商 API，也不上传统计数据。模型分类设置保存在 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-clear-usage/models.json`。

## 从零认识这个项目

1. `package.json`：插件的名字、版本和安装声明。
2. `cordis.patch.yml`：告诉 DSH 加载这个插件。
3. `index.js` 与 `lib/usage.js`：读取、核对和统计用量。
4. `client.js`：设置页界面。

本地安装采用目录链接。保留本项目目录；移动或删除目录会影响 DSH 加载。修改界面后通常可以热更新，修改宿主统计代码后需要正常重启 DSH。

plugins.description: GitMate — a smart Git panel for DeepSeek Harness: diffs, generated commit messages, a commit graph with rewind, and .gitignore generation, plus ten agent tools.
plugins.readme_text:
# GitMate

**A Git panel in the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) sidebar — plus the same operations as fifteen agent tools.**

Runs anywhere the Harness does: macOS, Linux, and Windows (PowerShell).

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Review changes, read diffs, stage, commit with a generated message, merge, stash, sync, and rewind history without leaving the panel. Every operation is also a tool the agent can call, so asking in chat works too.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:alanhaskey/dsh-gitmate
```

Restart DSH once, refresh the page, then open **GitMate** from the sidebar's **+** menu.

> The internal ids (Loader row `dsh-git`, tab key) differ from the package name on purpose: the row id is the key of a config row you may already have, and renaming it would orphan your saved settings.

## Reviewing and committing

- **Four groups** — conflicts, staged, changes, untracked. Each row shows the kind in words, the path, and that file's `+N −M`. Row actions stage, unstage, and discard, with a second click for anything destructive.
- **Diffs like an editor** — two line-number gutters, `+`/`−` markers, tinted rows, and only the changed span of a replaced line marked. Click a file to expand it in place; click again to collapse. Widen the context from 3 lines to 24 when a hunk needs more of the file.
- **One row of list actions**, shown only when they would do something, with the counts in the labels.
- **Amend** — fold the staged changes into the previous commit; leaving the message box empty keeps the existing message.
- **A draggable splitter** between the list and the commit card resizes the message box.
- **A panel that is working says so** — every operation shows a turning indicator and names itself ("Committing…", "Reviewing the staged changes…") instead of only greying its buttons out. It sits with the messages at the foot of the list, above the splitter, so it never covers the commit box.

## AI features

| Feature | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Commit message** | Generated from the staged diff. If you have already typed something, the button becomes *Refine draft*: the model keeps your intent and fills in the rest instead of replacing it. |
| **Review before commit** | Reads the staged changes and reports only what would bite — a wrong result, a missed edge case, an unhandled error, a committed secret, debug output left in, a behaviour change with no test. Click a finding to open that file's diff. |
| **Split this commit** | Divides the staged changes into commits that each stand on their own, with a message for each. The plan is a draft you can edit: rewrite any message, merge a group into the one above, remove one, ask for a new plan, commit one group at a time, or commit them all in order. Each commit leaves the other files staged. |
| **Explain a change** | Two to five bullets on what a file's change does, so you can review without reading every line. |
| **`.gitignore`** | Infers the rules from the project's manifests and layout. One button creates it, one adds what is missing. |

Buttons that call a model are marked **AI**. Every generation uses the session's default model — there is no second model to configure.

## Branches, history, remotes

- **Branch selector** — switch, create, delete, and merge any branch into the checked-out one. A conflicted merge is reported with the files that need a decision, and can be aborted.
- **Commit graph** — every branch and remote-tracking branch, not just this one. Expand a commit for its full message, the files it touched, and what you can do to it: rewind, revert, cherry-pick, rebase, or tag. Click a changed file to see its diff inside that commit.
- **Remotes** — push, pull, fetch, and a **Sync** that fetches, fast-forwards, then pushes. It refuses to merge a diverged branch rather than inventing a merge commit.
- **Stash** — set work aside and take it back later (pop, apply, drop).

## Setup

One click initialises a repository and writes the local commit identity; two buttons handle `.gitignore`. Nothing is chosen from a list of ecosystems — the plugin reads the project and decides.

## Configuration

Settings live in this plugin's own row in `cordis.patch.yml`, so they survive upgrades and stay visible on the Plugins page. Everything below is a button or a checkbox; there is nothing to type unless you want custom instructions.

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `messageLanguage` | `auto` | Language of generated text: `auto` (follow the repository), `en`, `zh`. When unset or `auto`, the panel's own messages read as Chinese. |
| `messageStyle` | `conventional` | `conventional` (`feat: …`) or `plain`. |
| `messageTemplate` | — | Extra instructions, appended last so they override the defaults. |
| `signoff` | `false` | Add a `Signed-off-by` trailer. |
| `defaultBranch` | `main` | Branch created by *Initialise*. |
| `maxPromptBytes` | `24000` | Diff text handed to the model per change set. |
| `maxDiffBytes` | `80000` | Patch text a tool returns before truncating. |
| `commandTimeoutMs` | `60000` | Per git command; network commands get four times this. |

## Safety

- **Nothing destructive happens on a single click.** Discarding, deleting a branch, dropping a stash, rebasing, and rewinding all ask first, and say what will be lost.
- **Rewinding and reverting are separate**, because they are: rewinding moves the branch and rewrites history, reverting adds an inverse commit and is safe for anything already pushed. The panel warns before a rewind that would rewrite published history.
- **"Undo this commit" and "rewind to here" are separate too.** On the newest commit the button undoes that commit and leaves its changes staged, unstaged, or deleted as you choose; on an older commit it moves the branch pointer back to that commit. The notice names the commit that was actually undone and always states how many were discarded — including none.
- **A refusal says which mode refused.** A read-only session cannot write `.git`, so committing and switching branches are rejected by design; the message names the mode and what to switch to. If it is already `danger-full-access` and still refused, the sandbox backend on that machine is refusing writes and the Harness needs restarting — two different problems, told apart.
- **git's own diagnostics are pinned to English** (`LC_ALL=C`). The plugin's text is still localised by the setting; git's is kept stable because the phrase table in `lib/text.js` matches English sentences, and a localised git defeats it — worse on Windows, where git writes in the console code page and the pipeline decodes UTF-8, so a Chinese message arrives as mojibake.
- **Every tool call runs git under the calling session's permission mode**, with the deployment default only as a fallback. The panel's route has no session, so it passes no policy at all and leaves the choice to the Host.
- **"git could not be run" and "this is not a repository" are different failures**, and the panel says which: the first gives the reason and a retry instead of inviting you to `git init` a repository that exists and merely cannot be read. An environment problem such as a sandbox that will not start is explained in one sentence, with the original cause kept.
- **Model output is treated as untrusted input.** A review finding that names a file which is not staged is dropped; a split plan that does not cover every staged file is flagged; an answer that does not parse is shown as-is rather than reported as "nothing found".
- **Nothing is committed, pushed, or repaired automatically.** The AI features produce material for a decision, not the decision.

## Development

```sh
node test/smoke.mjs     # 562 assertions; runs real git, no DSH required
```

```
lib/plugin.js      entry point; reloads the implementation when it changes
lib/impl.js        operations + the fifteen agent tools
lib/git-core.js    git operations, patch parsing, the commit-graph layout
lib/messages.js    prompts and model calls for text generation
lib/review.js      pre-commit review and split planning
lib/text.js        panel messages in both languages
lib/rpc.js         the p

plugins.description: 密码门禁：打开 DSH 时先显示密码界面，解锁后才能使用；支持手动锁定与自动锁定，密码以 scrypt 单向哈希存储。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-lock

给 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）网页版加一道**密码门禁**：打开页面先显示锁定界面，输入密码解锁后才能使用。

## 功能

- **全屏遮罩**：未解锁时覆盖整个界面，阻止直接操作会话
- **手动锁定**：随时一键锁定（侧边栏按钮 + 快捷键）
- **自动锁定**：可配置空闲时长后自动锁定
- **密码安全**：仅存 scrypt 单向哈希，**永不保存明文**
- **界面中英双语**：跟随 DSH 的界面语言设置实时切换（见下方「界面文案（运行时 locale）」）

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:felixpu/dsh-lock
```

安装后重启宿主进程。

## 使用

| 操作 | 方式 |
|---|---|
| 解锁 | 在锁定界面输入密码 |
| 立即锁定 | 侧边栏底部「锁定」按钮 |
| 立即锁定（快捷键） | macOS / Windows：`Ctrl/Cmd + Shift + L`；Linux：`Ctrl/Cmd + Shift + .` |
| 自动锁定时长 | 设置 → 插件 → dsh-lock |

> Linux 用 `Ctrl/Cmd + Shift + .` 而非 `Ctrl/Cmd + Shift + L`：DSH 平台的 Linux 键位白名单
> 不接受「修饰键 + 字母」，为各平台分别声明才不会被校验拒绝。

## 配置

本包不导出 `Config` schema，密码与自动锁定设置由插件自身持久化，通过「设置 → 插件 → dsh-lock」面板管理。

## 安全说明

- 密码以 **scrypt**（N=2^15, r=8, p=1）加盐哈希存储，比对使用常量时间比较
- 解锁后签发的是短期令牌，而非保存密码本身
- 存储位置在插件私有目录下，卸载插件不会把密码留在会话或配置里

> ⚠️ 这是**界面门禁**，不是磁盘加密。它防的是「别人走到你电脑前直接操作 DSH」，
> 不能防止能读取你用户目录下文件的攻击者。

## 宿主贡献

- `inject: ['webServer']`，注册解锁/锁定相关的同源路由
- 无客户端以外的外部依赖
- **不产出面向用户的自然语言**：所有路由响应只回机器可读的 `error` code
  （如 `invalid-password` / `too-many-attempts` / `locked`），由客户端字典翻译。
  宿主无从知道 UI 语言，写死中/英文都会在另一种语言下露馅。
  唯一保留自然语言的地方是宿主**日志**（`ctx.logger.info`），那是给开发者看的。

## 界面文案（运行时 locale）

界面文案走**平台官方 locale 服务**，中英双语：

```js
// client/client.js
inject: ['slots', 'shortcuts', 'locale'],
apply(ctx) {
  ctx.effect(() => ctx.locale.register(NS, { zh, en }), NS + ': dictionaries');
  const t = ctx.locale.bind(NS);
  ctx.slots.register({ name: 'shell.overlay', id: '…', locale: NS }, Veil); // ← 渲染器据此注入 t
}
```

组件从 `props.t` 拿翻译函数，**不需要**自己 `inject: () => ({ t })` ——
槽注册选项里给了 `locale: NS`，渲染器（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-renderer` 的
`standardKit()`）会把绑定好的 `t` 注入 props；缺 locale 插件时它会抛出明确的
`SlotAssemblyError`，而不是静默渲染出 key 名。

约定：

- 一条消息 = 一个完整句子，变量用 `{name}` 占位（如 `'autoLock.minutes': '{n} 分钟'` /
  `'{n} minutes'`）。**不拆片段拼接**，否则中英语序无法重排。
- 键名小写点分层级：`lock.title`、`field.password`、`button.unlock`、
  `error.wrongPassword`、`autoLock.minutes`。
- `retry` / `loading` / `unknown` 等平台 `common` 命名空间已有的通用词**不重复定义**，
  查表未命中会自动回落到 common。
- **zh 与 en 的键必须完全一致**：运行时不校验，漏键只会显示 key 名。故 `apply` 里
  做了一次键一致性自查，不一致时 `console.warn` 点名缺的键。
- 需要本地化的字符串**不能**只存在于源码字面量里 —— 静态审计
  （去掉注释后 grep 中文字符）应只剩注释与宿主日志。

## 展示元数据（locale）

`locale/en.json` 与 `locale/zh.json` 提供**插件展示元数据**（`meta.title` / `meta.description`），
Plugin Manager 与设置页**无需激活插件**即可读取，用于显示本地化的插件名与说明。
这与运行时 UI 文案（客户端 `ctx.locale.register`，见上一节）是**两套互不相关**的东西：
前者是 JSON 资源、由宿主按 Node 模块解析器读取；后者是客户端代码里的字典对象。

```json
{ "meta": { "title": "…", "description": "…" } }
```

⚠️ 两个容易漏的点（漏任一个都会**静默失效**，不报错）：

1. **必须在 `package.json` 的 `exports` 里导出 `./locale/*.json`** —— 宿主经 Node 模块解析器
   读取该资源，未导出的子路径会得到 `ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED`，被当作「没有 locale」跳过。
2. **`files` 需包含 `locale`** —— 否则 `pnpm pack` / `npm publish` 的产物里不会带上它。

`icon.svg` 走顶层 `icon` 字段（相对路径），**不需要** `exports`。

## 客户端挂载点

| 槽位 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| 全屏遮罩 | 未解锁时的锁定界面 |
| `sidebar.footer.action` | 「立即锁定」按钮 |
| `plugins.bundle.config` | 自动锁定设置面板 |

客户端 bundle 仅 `require` 平台种子表内的模块（本包只用到 `react`）。
槽位 / 快捷键 / 语言三个服务通过 `package.json` 的 `dsh.client.inject` 声明，
在插件对象 `inject: ['slots', 'shortcuts', 'locale']` 里注入 —— 服务不走 `require`。

快捷键的 `label` 用**函数**（thunk）而非字符串，语言切换后快捷键面板那一行会跟着变；
`aliases` 是快捷键面板的**搜索别名**、平台没有本地化机制，故只放英文
（官方各包一律如此），写死中文会让英文界面下露出中文。

## 许可证

MIT © felixpu

## 仓库

<https://github.com/felixpu/dsh-lock>

plugins.description: Codex-style Create Workspace dialog for DeepSeek Harness: type a name and the folder is created for you, or pick a folder with a native chooser that remembers where you were.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-workspace-create-dialog

[English](README.md) | [中文](README.zh.md)

A **Create Workspace** dialog for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): type a name and go, or pick a folder with a chooser that finally remembers where you were.

![The Create Workspace dialog: a name field, a workspace folder row with a Choose folder button, and a New workspace location row with a Change button](docs/create-workspace.png)

## What it does

Clicking **Add workspace…** in DSH today opens the OS folder dialog immediately. This plugin replaces that with a small dialog that asks two independent questions: what is the workspace called, and where does it live. Answer the first only and it creates the folder for you; answer the second and the folder you picked *is* the workspace.

| You do | You get |
| --- | --- |
| Type a name, press **Create** | A new folder with that name is created under **New workspace location**, registered as a workspace, and a session opens in it |
| Click **Choose folder…** | The native Windows folder dialog, starting **where you left off**, not at some default |
| Choose a folder, leave the name empty | The name fills itself in from the folder's own name |
| Choose a folder, having typed a name | Your name wins — the workspace is registered, then renamed to it |
| Click **Change…** on New workspace location | Pick where name-only workspaces go from now on; the choice is saved and survives restarts |
| Cancel / Esc / click the backdrop | Nothing happens — no folder, no registration |

### The effect, before and after

| | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Creating `my-project` | Create the folder in Explorer first, then hunt for it in the picker | Type `my-project`. Done |
| The folder picker's starting point | The OS default, every single time | The directory you last chose |
| Where new workspaces land | Wherever you navigate to | A location you set once, visible in the dialog, changeable any time |
| Naming a workspace after its folder | Retype the folder name | Auto-filled |

## Install

### From the DSH UI (simplest)

Sidebar → **Plugins** → **Add plugin**, paste this address, click **Install**, then **Enable now**:

```text
https://github.com/LanFeng97/dsh-workspace-create-dialog
```

That box takes a package name, a Git address, a tarball or a local absolute path. A repository URL works because this package ships a `dsh.bundle` patch — DSH checks exactly that before it installs. Restart DeepSeek Harness if the plugin does not come up.

Two things worth knowing: it downloads straight from GitHub, so GitHub has to be reachable (the China-mirror option only covers registry packages, not repository downloads); and DSH does not auto-update third-party plugins yet — upgrading means uninstall + install again.

> Already installed with `tools/install.mjs` below? Run `node tools/install.mjs --uninstall` first, so the profile does not end up with two loader rows for the same id.

### One-line prompt for your agent

If you would rather not click through it:

```text
Install the DSH plugin at https://github.com/LanFeng97/dsh-workspace-create-dialog into my DSH and tell me when to restart.
```

### From the plugin market (once listed)

Search for **dsh-workspace-create-dialog** in [dshmarket](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market) and install it in one click. The listing is [pending a PR](contrib/awesome-dsh-plugin/) to [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) (their CI requires the repository to be at least one day old); until it lands, use the routes above and below.

### Manual install from this repository

```sh
git clone https://github.com/LanFeng97/dsh-workspace-create-dialog
cd dsh-workspace-create-dialog
node tools/install.mjs
```

That copies the package into your DSH profile's `node_modules` and appends one loader line to the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. It resolves your DSH home the same way the harness does — explicit config, then `$DSH_HOME`, then `~/.dsh`.

**Then restart DeepSeek Harness** (the host half is a Node module, so a config reload alone will not import it). After that, changing `lib/client.js` only needs a page refresh; changing `lib/index.js` still needs a restart.

`node tools/install.mjs --dry-run` prints what it would do without writing anything; `--uninstall` removes the package and its loader row again.

Publishing to npm is **not** required: the market installs from GitHub exactly the same way, and listing is unaffected either way.

## How it works

### It uses the official extension point, not a patch

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace` declares a `single` slot where the "pick a directory" step is handed to whichever plugin fills it:

```text
sidebar.workspaces.directoryFlow              ← the sidebar's "Add workspace…"
conversation.hero.workspace.directoryFlow     ← the empty-state entry
```

The owner hands the occupant the whole interaction contract:

```ts
interface DirectoryFlowOwnerProps {
  open: boolean                     // a pick is requested
  busy: boolean                     // the owner is adopting the picked path
  onPicked: (path: string) => void  // report the directory; the owner registers it and opens a session
  onCancel: () => void
  onError: (message: string) => void
}
```

This plugin registers its own occupant into both slots at **priority -100**. A `single` slot renders the lowest-priority entry, the shipped native driver sits at `0`, so this dialog wins (two entries at the *same* priority throw, which is the official protection against ambiguity). Removing the loader line from your profile patch restores the stock behaviour exactly.

### Why the folder dialog is built here instead of reused

The desktop app opens its folder dialog from the Electron main process without a starting directory:

```js
// D:\App\DSH\resources\app.asar → lib/main.js
dialog.showOpenDialog(window, { properties: ['openDirectory', 'createDirectory'] })
```

There is no `defaultPath`, which is exactly why the chooser always starts in the same place. A plugin cannot reach that call: the DSH host is a *child process* of Electron. So `lib/pick-folder.js` opens its own `IFileDialog` — a small C# COM interop compiled and run by the **Windows PowerShell 5.1 that ships with Windows**:

- **no dependencies**: no koffi, no PowerShell 7, no native module to publish;
- compilation happens **in memory** (~120 ms per call), so there is no DLL cache to corrupt or lock;
- the one line that matters is `IFileDialog::SetFolder` — the remembered directory as the starting point;
- the dialog runs in a child process, so a native fault cannot take the host down.

The C# method declaration order must match the COM vtable (`Show=3`, `SetOptions=9`, `SetFolder=12`, `SetTitle=17`, `GetResult=20`). Getting it wrong does not error — it just silently does the wrong thing — so a self-test asserts the order.

## Where name-only workspaces are created

The **New workspace location** is resolved in this order (`lib/base-dir.js`, a pure function):

1. **What you set in the dialog** — highest priority; once you change it, it is yours;
2. **`config.baseDir`** from your profile patch — the value used at install time;
3. **The root of your default workspace** — the parent of the workspace whose directory is named `default-workspace` (a name the harness fixes, independent of UI language). New workspaces land next to it. This is the default for a fresh install;
4. **Fallback** — `<Documents>/deepseek-harness`, or `<home>/deepseek-harness` when there is no Documents folder.

The resolved value is written to the state file, so "what it was on first run" is decided once and only you change it afterwards. `config.baseDir` is a seed, not an order.

## HTTP routes

All four are loopback-guarded (loopback socket + loopback `Host` + same-origin marker; `x-forwarded-for` is never trusted) — they create directories and open windows on the host machine, so nothing off-machine may reach them.

| Route | Method | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/api/dsh-workspace-create/config` | GET | Current location + last directory |
| `/api/dsh-workspace-create/base-dir` | POST | `{"

plugins.description: 把电脑串口接进 DeepSeek Harness——让 AI 能看见 Arduino/STM32/ESP32 的运行时输出（面板 + AI 工具双通道）
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-serial（面板 + AI 工具双通道）

把电脑的串口接进 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（dsh）——
**让 AI 能看见 Arduino / STM32 / ESP32 / 51 单片机的运行时输出。**

## 两条通道，如下所示

| 通道 | 主用户 | 入口 |  作用  |
|---|---|---|---|
| 悬浮球面板 | 人 | 右下角悬浮球（可拖动移位，点击开面板） | 选口连接、实时看日志、演示模式、手动发送、复制日志 |
| AI 工具 | AI | 对话框里直接说 | `serial_list_ports` 列串口 / `serial_read` 读串口并自动分析 |

两条通道**共用同一个串口服务实例**——面板开着的口，AI 工具直接从它的实时缓冲取数据，
不会出现"同一 COM 口被抢"的冲突（Windows 上同一串口不能被两个程序同时打开）。

## 原理

```
单片机跑程序 ──UART──▶ USB转串口芯片(CH340) ──USB──▶ 操作系统 COM 口 ──▶ 本插件 ──▶ 面板 / AI
└────────────── 硬件的世界，插件的代码从 COM 口右边才开始 ──────────────┘
```

- UART 协议、电平、时序——全部由硬件和 `serialport` 库封装，插件只管理"读已解好的字节流"
- 插件无构建：纯 JS 源码即运行产物（Host 半 `lib/`，Browser 半 `client/`）

## 文件结构

```
dsh-serial/
├── package.json          # 包配置：dsh.bundle.patch（装入声明）+ dsh.client（浏览器端声明）
├── cordis.patch.yml      # 安装补丁：把插件插入 profile 的插件层
├── lib/
│   ├── index.js          # 入口：注册串口服务 + 两个 AI 工具 + 挂载面板路由
│   ├── service.js        # 串口服务引擎（列口/开关/读/写/演示模式，环形缓冲）
│   └── routes.js         # 面板数据通道：HTTP 路由 /dsh-serial/api/*（官方 webServer 扩展点）
├── client/
│   └── client.js         # Browser 半：悬浮球面板（可拖拽 + 自适应定位，纯原生 DOM）
├── tools/
│   ├── serial-smoke.mjs       # 独立串口验证脚本（不依赖 dsh）
│   ├── mock-load-test.mjs     # Host 半模拟加载测试（工具注册/路由/安全）
│   └── client-load-test.mjs   # Browser 半行为测试（拖拽/定位/缩放，vm 模拟 DOM）
├── README.md
├── LICENSE                    # MIT
└── .gitignore
```

## 安装

```bash
# 1. 在本目录安装依赖（serialport）
npm install --registry=https://registry.npmmirror.com

# 2. 装进 dsh 的 desktop profile（二选一）
# 方式 A（推荐）：官方 CLI
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:<本目录绝对路径>

# 方式 B：手动三件套
#   ① profiles/desktop/package.json 的 dependencies 加：
#        "dsh-serial": "link:<本目录绝对路径>"
#   ② profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml 追加：
#        - insert:
#            - id: dsh-serial
#              name: 'dsh-serial'
#   ③ 在 profiles/desktop 目录执行 pnpm install

# 3. 重启 dsh 桌面版
```

## 验证（三层实例，逐层加码）

**Level 0 · 不依赖 dsh（先验证最底层）**

```bash
node tools/serial-smoke.mjs                    # 应列出本机串口
node tools/serial-smoke.mjs COM3 9600 3000     # 插上板子后读取 3 秒
```

**Level 1 · 面板通道（无需硬件，使用插件演示模式）**

重启 dsh 后：界面右下角出现"串口"悬浮球 → 点开 → 点"演示模式" →
看到模拟数据（即模拟DHT11 温湿度 + HC-SR04 距离）每 0.8 秒滚动，证明面板链路通畅。

**Level 2 · AI 工具通道（无需硬件即可验证注册）**

在 dsh 新会话里对 AI 提出：

> 列一下我电脑上有哪些串口

预期：AI 调用 `serial_list_ports` 返回本机串口列表（蓝牙/虚拟口也算入）。

**Level 3 · 完整闭环（注意：需要板子完成验证）**

1. Arduino 烧一个每秒打印的程序（见下）
2. 对 AI 提出：`读一下 COM3 五秒，告诉我板子在打印什么`
3. 预期：AI 返回日志原样内容 + 自己的解读；如果此时面板正开着同一个口，工具会自动改用实时缓冲

```cpp
// Arduino 测试程序
void setup() {
  Serial.begin(9600);          // 波特率必须和读取时一致
}
void loop() {
  Serial.println("hello from board");
  delay(1000);
}
```

**Level 4 · 制造故障（体验"AI 诊断硬件"）**

把读取的波特率改成 115200（与程序的 9600 故意不一致），再让 AI 读取。
预期：AI 收到乱码，且主动提示"疑似波特率不匹配"——这属于 AI 看串口的实用价值之一。

## 降级设计（防御策略）

| 缺失的东西 | 后果 | 兜底 |
|---|---|---|
| `webServer` 服务（无 Web UI 的环境，如 headless） | 面板没有数据通道 | 工具通道照常工作，插件不崩 |
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`（defineTool 包装器） | 少一层参数校验 | 工具原样注册，功能不变 |
| `serialport` 库 | 真实串口不可用 | 演示模式可用，面板提示原因 |

## 已知边界

- 面板 UI 是原生 DOM 悬浮球（不碰 React/设置页 slot）——v0.2 再考虑升级进官方 slot
- 无构建流程：赢在改一行刷新即生效，输在没有类型检查（靠实测兜底）

## 更新记录

- **v0.1.6**（2026-10-10 夜）：**面板美化批次**（纯视觉层，功能逻辑零改动）——A 静奢玻璃（半透明磨砂 + 内高光 + 进场动画 + 连接成功描边闪绿）+ C 日志语义色（事件蓝/警告琥珀/错误红 + 新行淡入）+ **"信号喷鲸"品牌主题**（标题栏小鲸标记 + 日志空状态水印「监听中 · 等待设备输出…」+ 轻微浮动）；三态状态灯（灰/琥珀呼吸/绿光晕）；发送行 ❯ 提示符；小窗口防裁切（面板高度 78vh + 内容可滚动）；悬浮球维持经典波形款。
- **v0.1.5**（2026-10-10）：面板标题栏新增**关闭按钮**（面板遮挡悬浮球时也能关闭；点击球关闭保留，两种方式并存）；用法说明重写为**专业版**（使用说明 + 辅助功能两段，覆盖连接/异常自动提示/刷新/演示/发送/复制日志）。
- **v0.1.4**（2026-10-10）：功能健壮性批次——连接/重开/失败/停止**事件留痕**（面板与 AI 同一时间线）；**乱码双告警**（4KB 无换行 + 连续乱码行，限频）；`serial_read`"读 N 秒"改为**真实时间窗**；活动波特率只在打开成功后生效；start/stop **串行化**（防双击竞态）；关闭串口兜底超时；端口名大小写不敏感；日志游标越界自愈；面板重连失败状态复位、日志 DOM 上限、输入法回车修复、send 8KB 上限。
- **v0.1.3**（2026-10-10）：修复桌面版点「连接」报 403（`same-origin POST required`）——桌面版 Electron 代理会剥离 `origin/host` 等请求头，POST 同源校验改为「有则校验、无则放行」（与 dshmarket 同款实战验证规则）；反拒绝留痕便于诊断。
- **v0.1.2**（2026-10-10）：桌面版适配——悬浮球可拖拽（位置记忆）；面板改为贴球自适应定位（自动翻转 + 视口钳制 + 高度随窗口伸缩 + 宽度按视口比例），小窗口下不再溢出屏幕。
- **v0.1.1**（2026-10-08）：样式修复（白块按钮 → 品牌蓝）+ 整体放大；数据通道由 RPC 重构为 HTTP 路由（解决第三方插件 RPC 不可用的架构死路）。
- **v0.1.0**（2026-10-08）：初稿——面板 + AI 工具双通道打通，演示模式与真机（CH340/COM4）验证通过。

plugins.description: 🗃️ 为 DSH 默认只加载基础工具，其余工具通过 activate_tools 按需加载。| Load only basic DSH tools by default, and activate the rest on demand via activate_tools.
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-tool-activator [![npm version][npm-version-src]][npm-version-href] [![npm downloads][npm-downloads-src]][npm-downloads-href] [![bundle][bundle-src]][bundle-href] [![JSDocs][jsdocs-src]][jsdocs-href] [![License][license-src]][license-href] 为 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 减少初始工具上下文：默认仅展示基础工具，其余工具通过 `activate_tools` 按需加载。 * **系统要求**：DSH $\ge$ `0.2.0-rc.2`；Node.js $\ge$ `22.19.0`。 --- ## 核心行为 默认基础工具为 `read`、`glob`、`grep`、`write`、`edit`、`skill`、`ask_user_question`、`todo_write`。 模型每次都看到：基础工具、已激活工具、`activate_tools`，以及其余工具的 `` 简述目录。 ### 默认启用的工具 `read`、`glob`、`grep`、`write`、`edit`、`skill`、`ask_user_question`、`todo_write` ### 可通过 `activate_tools` 加载的工具 其余已安装且在当前 agent 作用域可见的工具默认隐藏，由模型按标识激活。常见内置工具： | 分类 | 工具标识 | | --- | --- | | 文件写入 | `write`、`edit` | | 命令执行 | `bash`、`pwsh` | | 联网 | `web_search`、`web_fetch` | | 后台任务 | `job_output`、`job_list`、`job_kill` | | 终端 | `terminal_open`、`terminal_send`、`terminal_read`、`terminal_signal`、`terminal_close`、`terminal_list` | | 目标 | `get_goal`、`create_goal`、`update_goal` | | 会话检索 | `session_search`、`session_event_search`、`session_trace`、`session_event_trace`、`session_event_read` | | 代码智能 | `lsp` | | 编排 | `subagent`、`subagent_fork`、`workflow`、`ralph`、`structured_output` | 此外，任意已安装插件的工具都可作为标识请求；开启 `autoGroupMcp` 时，`mcp__server__tool` 还会按 server 聚合为 `mcp.server`。 实际可用集合将以 `` 目录呈现，该目录随提示词注入给模型，只有标识、名称和一句简述： ```xml Search the public web for current information. send: Send a message through the mailbox. ``` 模型可按需请求加载工具或组： ```json { "identifiers": ["web_search", "web_fetch"], "reason": "需要检索并核对用户要求的公开资料" } ``` --- ## 配置 进入官方插件管理页，打开 `dsh-tool-activator` 卡片，配置表单直接显示在该插件的页面上。 表单显示工具列表： | 分区 | 含义 | | --- | --- | | **默认激活** | 每次请求都带完整 schema 的工具；自带八个基础工具固定在此，标题右侧带"基础工具"标记，不被允许关闭 | | **按需激活** | 其余工具，模型可使用 `activate_tools` 按需获取 | 打开某一项的开关即把它写进 `basicTools`（默认加载），关闭则移回按需区；工具清单与描述由宿主 Remote `toolActivator/catalog` 提供，覆盖当前所有 live agent 作用域。 **常规**区两个开关：`requireApproval`（非完全权限时激活前请求确认，缺少审批服务时直接拒绝；完全权限 `danger-full-access` 时无需确认，即使审批策略为 `never`）与 `autoGroupMcp`（按 `mcp__server__tool` 前缀聚合同一 MCP 服务） **工具分组**区是结构化编辑器：每个分组有标识符、名称、说明、工具勾选（只能从当前目录里的真实工具中选）和说明节绑定，支持增删；留空则每个工具各自成为条目。`sectionTools` 仍留在 schema 里（进阶用法：说明节到工具名的依赖映射），但不再出现在表单中。 --- ## 状态、审批与生命周期 * **执行路由**：通过 DSH 原有 dispatcher 执行，不改变底层沙箱或运行路由。 * **持久化与恢复**：已完成的激活状态随标准会话日志和 seed 恢复，不依赖中途内存状态。 * **生命周期**：Cordis 负责注册、监听及 HMR 清理，卸载时自动清理样式与实例。 --- * **测试情况**：2026-10-11 完全权限修复后，12 个文件、304 个用例全部通过；lint、类型检查与 Build 同样通过。 * **未验证项**：真实 GUI E2E、打包发布及真实 profile 验证。 --- ## 许可证 MIT 第三方声明见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md]()。 [npm-version-src]: https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-tool-activator?style=flat&colorA=080f12&colorB=1fa669 [npm-version-href]: https://npmjs.com/package/dsh-tool-activator [npm-downloads-src]: https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-tool-activator?style=flat&colorA=080f12&colorB=1fa669 [npm-downloads-href]: https://npmjs.com/package/dsh-tool-activator [bundle-src]: https://img.shields.io/bundlephobia/minzip/dsh-tool-activator?style=flat&colorA=080f12&colorB=1fa669&label=minzip [bundle-href]: https://bundlephobia.com/result?p=dsh-tool-activator [jsdocs-src]: https://img.shields.io/badge/jsdocs-reference-080f12?style=flat&colorA=080f12&colorB=1fa669 [jsdocs-href]: https://www.jsdocs.io/package/dsh-tool-activator [license-src]: https://img.shields.io/github/license/hairyf/dsh-tool-activator.svg?style=flat&colorA=080f12&colorB=1fa669 [license-href]: https://github.com/hairyf/dsh-tool-activator/blob/main/LICENSE.md

plugins.description: Turn your local Obsidian vault into a RAG chat panel inside DeepSeek Harness (DSH). 100% local BM25 retrieval, clickable citations. 把本地 Obsidian 变成 DSH 的本地知识库对话面板。
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-obsidian-board [English](#english) | [中文](#中文) A [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that turns your local **Obsidian vault** into a **dedicated RAG chat panel** inside the DSH web GUI — a sidebar entry leading to a full three-pane page: note browser on the left, retrieval-augmented chat in the middle, cited note source on the right. All retrieval and indexing run **100% locally** (BM25 + CJK bigram); answers go through the model channel you already configured in DSH. > **Not an MCP integration, not an Obsidian plugin** — this is a dual-half DSH plugin (host + browser client). The UI is injected into the DSH main window as a `main` slot page (same mechanism as switching conversations); model calls reuse the host `ctx.llm`; the knowledge base points at your local vault directory (Obsidian doesn't even need to be running). ## Features - 🔍 **Local-first retrieval** — BM25 with CJK bigram tokenization, title/path boosting, Obsidian tag & alias awareness. No embedding model, no network, no data leaves your machine. - 📖 **Clickable citations** — every `[n]` in the answer and the citation chips below it open the exact note in the right-hand source pane. - 🗂 **Automatic vault discovery** — reads Obsidian's own vault registry, scans common locations, offers a native directory picker, or takes a pasted path. - ⚡ **Incremental indexing** — mtime-based; full scan of a 10k-note vault in under a second, incremental refresh in ~50 ms. - 🧩 **Native panel experience** — registered under the sidebar "Panels" group (alongside the plugin manager and timer); the panel keeps its own chat history in the browser, separate from DSH session logs. ## Install **Option 1 — dsh-market (in-app, easiest):** search `obsidian` in the DSH plugin market and install. **Option 2 — CLI:** ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add "dsh-obsidian-board" ``` **Option 3 — from source (this repo):** ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add file:"" ``` Or manually: add `"dsh-obsidian-board": "file:"` to `dependencies` and `"dsh-obsidian-board"` to `dsh.profile.bundles` in `~/.dsh/profiles//package.json`, then run `pnpm install` in that directory and restart DSH. ## Configure Set the vault path in your profile patch (`~/.dsh/profiles//cordis.patch.yml`): ```yaml - insert: - id: dsh-obsidian-board name: dsh-obsidian-board config: vaultPath: "D:\\notes\\MyVault" # vault root (absolute; ~ works too) provider: "" # DSH llm provider route; empty = host default model: "" # model id; empty = provider default topK: 8 # chunks cited per answer chunkLimit: 1200 # max chars per chunk in the prompt systemPrompt: "" # custom RAG system prompt (empty = built-in) ``` > `vaultPath` may stay empty — the panel shows a setup card on first open where you can discover/pick/paste the vault path interactively. ## Usage 1. Click **Obsidian** in the sidebar "Panels" group (or the sidebar footer entry). 2. First time: pick your vault → connect (indexing is instant and local). 3. Ask things like *"what do my notes say about X?"* or *"summarize the points under #tag"*. 4. Click `[1]` `[2]` citations or the chips under the answer → the note opens on the right. ## How it works ``` dsh-obsidian-board/ ├── lib/ │ ├── index.js # Host half: ObsidianBoardGateway (TypertRemoteService) │ │ # status/configure/discoverVaults/pickVault/revealVault/ │ │ # listNotes/readNote/search/reindex/chat │ │ # BM25 runs locally; chat streams via ctx.llm (DSH model channel) │ ├── typert.js # RPC contract (dual-key codec, 0.1.5-rc.x and 0.1.6+ compatible) │ ├── vault.js # Zero-dependency Node indexer: scan/frontmatter/BM25/incremental │ └── client.js # Browser half: main-slot page + sidebar panellist/footer entries ├── cordis.patch.yml └── locale/*.json, icon.svg ``` The panel chat **does not write to DSH session logs**: history lives in browser localStorage and the host half is stateless (clearing after restart is expected). Model calls go through the host `ctx.llm`, so quotas, retries, and provider routing behave exactly like your main DSH sessions. ## Known limits - Retrieval is BM25 + CJK bigram + title/tag weighting — not semantic embedding search. Proper nouns, keywords, and tags work best; long paraphrased questions may miss recall (a local embedding model is planned as a follow-up; the interface is already reserved). - Panel history lives in localStorage — clearing browser data clears it. - The panel chat intentionally doesn't support DSH main-session tool calls / subagents (knowledge-base Q&A doesn't need them). ## License MIT --- # 中文 把本地 **Obsidian vault** 变成 DeepSeek Harness Web 里的**专属知识库对话页面**：侧栏多一个「Obsidian」入口，点开就是一个完整面板——左侧笔记浏览器、中间 RAG 聊天、右侧引用原文。检索（BM25 + 中文 bigram）与索引全部本地完成，回答走 DSH 已配置的模型通道。 > **不是 MCP 接入，也不是 Obsidian 插件**——这是一个 DSH 客户端+宿主双半插件：UI 注入进 DSH 主窗口（`main` slot 页面，与切换对话同构），模型调用复用宿主 `ctx.llm`，知识库指向你本地的 vault 目录（无需 Obsidian 运行）。 ## 特性 - 🔍 **本地优先检索**——BM25 + 中文 bigram 切词、标题/路径加权、Obsidian 标签与别名感知。不用 embedding、不联网、数据不出本机。 - 📖 **引用可点击**——回答里的 `[n]` 与底部引用 chips 都能点开右栏对应笔记原文。 - 🗂 **自动发现仓库**——读 Obsidian 自己的仓库注册表、扫描常见位置、支持系统目录选择对话框，或直接粘贴路径。 - ⚡ **增量索引**——按 mtime 增量刷新：万级笔记全量扫描 <1s，增量 <50ms。 - 🧩 **原生面板体验**——注册在侧栏「全局面板」组（与插件管理、定时任务同组）；面板对话历史独立存于浏览器，与 DSH 会话日志互不干扰。 ## 安装 **方式一——dsh-market（应用内，最简单）：** 在 DSH 插件市场搜 `obsidian` 安装。 **方式二——CLI：** ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add "dsh-obsidian-board" ``` **方式三——从本仓库源码：** ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add file:"<本仓库 clone 路径>" ``` 或手动：在 `~/.dsh/profiles//package.json` 的 `dependencies` 加 `"dsh-obsidian-board": "file:<路径>"`、`dsh.profile.bundles` 加 `"dsh-obsidian-board"`，然后在该目录 `pnpm install` 并重启 DSH。 ## 配置 编辑 profile 补丁（`~/.dsh/profiles//cordis.patch.yml`）里 `dsh-obsidian-board` 条目的 `config`： ```yaml - insert: - id: dsh-obsidian-board name: dsh-obsidian-board config: vaultPath: "D:\\笔记库\\MyVault" # vault 根目录（绝对路径；支持 ~ 开头） provider: "" # DSH llm provider 路由名；空=宿主默认路由 model: "" # 模型 id；空=provider 默认 topK: 8 # 每次回答引用的片段数 chunkLimit: 1200 # 单片段最大字符数 systemPrompt: "" # 自定义 RAG 系统提示词（空=内置） ``` > vaultPath 留空也可以：第一次打开面板时会有配置卡，在面板里直接发现/选择/粘贴路径连接。 ## 使用 1. 侧栏「全局面板」里点 **Obsidian**（或侧栏底部入口） 2. 首次使用：选 vault → 连接（索引本地毫秒级完成） 3. 直接提问：「我关于 X 的笔记说了什么」「总结 #标签 下的要点」 4. 回答里的 `[1]` `[2]` 引用与底部引用 chips 可点击 → 右栏打开笔记原文 ## 架构 ``` dsh-obsidian-board/ ├── lib/ │ ├── index.js # 宿主半：ObsidianBoardGateway（TypertRemoteService） │ │ # status/configure/discoverVaults/pickVault/revealVault/ │ │ # listNotes/readNote/search/reindex/chat │ │ # 检索本地 BM25；chat 走 ctx.llm.stream（DSH 模型通道） │ ├── typert.js # RPC 契约（双键 codec，兼容 0.1.5-rc.x 与 0.1.6+） │ ├── vault.js # 纯 Node 零依赖索引器：扫描/frontmatter/BM25/增量刷新 │ └── client.js # 客户端半：main slot 页面 + panellist/footer 入口 ├── cordis.patch.yml └── locale/*.json, icon.svg ``` ### 与 DSH 主会话的关系 面板对话**不写入 DSH session log**：历史存浏览器 localStorage，宿主半无状态（重启后面板历史清空是预期）。模型调用走宿主 `ctx.llm`，所以配额、重试、provider 路由与 DSH 主会话完全一致。 ## 已知边界 - 检索引擎是 BM25 + 中文 bigram + 标题/标签加权，不是 embedding 语义检索——专有名词、关键词、标签检索效果最好，长句意译可能漏召回（二期可挂本地 embedding 模型，接口已留好） - 面板历史存 localStorage，清浏览器数据会丢 - 面板会话不支持 DSH 主会话的工具调用/子代理（这是设计取舍：知识库问答不需要） ## License MIT

plugins.description: Parametric CAD tools for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — agent-driven mechanical design: CadQuery modeling, geometry validation, preview rendering, STEP/IGES/STL/3MF export
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-cad-design

Parametric CAD tools for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`) — let your agent do mechanical design: write CadQuery code for 3D parts or ezdxf code for 2D engineering drawings, validate the geometry, render a preview, and export manufacturing files (STEP / IGES / STL / 3MF / DXF).

**English** | [中文](#中文说明)

## What it does

```
You:  "Design an M8 hex-nut retainer, 3 mm wall, and export STEP"
Agent: loads the cadquery-design skill
     → cad_validate  (code + geometry check)
     → cad_render    (preview image + volume/bbox facts)
     → iterate until the design is right
     → cad_export    → retainer.step, ready for your CAM pipeline
```

Backends are pluggable **adapters** behind a capability-routing registry: the **CadQuery** adapter (OpenCASCADE kernel, native STEP) for 3D solids and the **ezdxf** adapter for 2D DXF drawings (with battle-tested repairs for common LLM drafting defects: missing TEXT align points, CJK font fallback, white-on-white preview colors). Tools auto-detect the backend from your script's imports, or you can pin it with the `backend` parameter / `backendPriority` config. OpenSCAD and FreeCAD adapters are on the roadmap; commercial CAD bridges (SolidWorks/NX/CATIA via COM, AutoCAD/ZWCAD/GstarCAD via console/LISP) are designed-for as separate future packages — the pragmatic meaning of "compatible with CATIA/SolidWorks/NX" is exchanging **STEP/IGES/DXF** files with them, which the adapter layer already targets.

## Prerequisites

- [dsh](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) `0.x`
- Python 3.10+ with CadQuery and/or ezdxf (install whichever backend you need):

  ```sh
  pip install cadquery    # 3D solids → STEP/IGES/STL/3MF
  pip install ezdxf matplotlib   # 2D drawings → DXF + previews
  # optional, for raster PNG previews of 3D models (self-contained wheels, no native DLLs):
  pip install matplotlib
  ```

  Run `cad_doctor` after installing the plugin — it probes the machine and prints a capability matrix with install hints.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-cad-design
dsh web
```

`dsh plugin` requires an explicit `--profile`; target a profile that carries a surface bundle. The shipped `web` profile (base + web-app) is the usual choice — a fresh custom profile created by `dsh plugin --profile <custom> add` contains only `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` (headless, no UI). Boot any profile as `dsh --profile <name>` with **no** surface argument; the surface comes from the profile's bundle list.

Or from a tarball: `dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-cad-design-0.1.0.tgz`

> **Name note:** npm also hosts [`dsh-cad`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-cad), a CAD *viewer* plugin by LAU-MARS (STL/OBJ/STEP/DXF preview cards in the Web UI). The two are complementary, not competing — `dsh-cad-design` creates and exports the models, `dsh-cad` can display them. This package was renamed to `dsh-cad-design` to keep both installable side by side.

## Tools

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `cad_doctor` | Probe all backends; report capability matrix + install hints. |
| `cad_validate` | Execute CadQuery (3D) or ezdxf (2D) code and check validity (`valid: false` is a domain result, not a crash). Backend auto-detected from imports or pinned with `backend`. |
| `cad_render` | Produce a preview (PNG when possible, SVG always) + facts (volume/bbox for 3D; entities/layers/repairs for 2D). Attaches the image when the current model supports image input; otherwise degrades to text + facts. |
| `cad_export` | Export STEP / IGES / STL / 3MF (CadQuery) or DXF (ezdxf). Never silently overwrites (`overwrite: true` to force). |
| `cad_convert` | File→file conversion: STEP/BREP → STEP/IGES/STL/3MF (CadQuery), DXF → DXF repair-and-normalize (ezdxf tolerant read + audit + TEXT repair + rewrite). |

Plus two auto-registered skills: **`cadquery-design`** (the `result` contract, mm units, Workplane selection rules, mechanical pattern library: cbore holes, nut traps, bolt-circle flanges, bearing seats, ribs, D-shaft bores) and **`ezdxf-drafting`** (2D contract, layer/linetype conventions, CJK-safe text styles, dimension patterns, and the pitfalls the runner auto-repairs).

## Configuration

Config lives in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (whole-line replace semantics — provide the full `config` block):

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: cad-tools
      name: dsh-cad-design
      config:
        workDir: ''               # default: <session cwd>/.dsh/cad
        timeoutSeconds: 120
        enableSkill: true
        backendPriority:          # routing order when several backends qualify
          - cadquery
          - ezdxf
        cadquery:
          enabled: true           # master switch for this backend
          pythonPath: ''          # absolute python.exe; empty = auto-detect
        ezdxf:
          enabled: true           # 2D DXF drafting backend
          pythonPath: ''
```

Environment variable `DSH_CAD_PYTHON` also overrides the interpreter.

## Security note

`cad_*` tools execute Python code on your machine (that is how parametric CAD works). The plugin implements no policy itself — use dsh's `tools/pre-execute` hooks for allow/deny/ask rules in shared or untrusted deployments.

## Development

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm test                              # unit tests (no CadQuery needed)
DSH_CAD_PYTHON=/path/to/python pnpm run test:e2e   # real-backend tests (auto-skip otherwise)
pnpm build && pnpm pack
```

Live development against a dsh checkout:

```sh
cd /path/to/deepseek-harness
pnpm dsh web --patch /absolute/path/to/dsh-cad/cordis.dev.yml
```

## Roadmap

- **v0.2** — ✅ ezdxf adapter (2D DXF drafting with CJK font handling and TEXT repair); ✅ `cad_convert` (file→file); still to come: OpenSCAD adapter
- **v0.3** — FreeCAD adapter (GB-standard engineering drawings), DWG via ODA File Converter
- **v1.0** — richer facts (mass, inertia), larger pattern libraries, drawing templates
- **later (separate packages)** — `dsh-cad-autocad` (accoreconsole/LISP), `dsh-cad-zwcad` / `dsh-cad-gstarcad` (COM-compatible), `dsh-cad-solidworks`, `dsh-cad-nx`
